## THE PILLARS, IN ONE BREATH (the long form is laws/BOHEMIA_LAWS_MASTER_9_4_26.md)
THERE ARE NO RUNS. A full game, ~100 hours, three generations that INHERIT (Gen 1
Animal, Gen 2 Human, Gen 3 Angel: ERAS, not creatures, Paolo 9/7; the player lives all three, AND FROM 9/23 ALL THREE AT ONCE: he flips between them and the future is computed from the past, laws/BOHEMIA_LAW_THE_THREE_ACTS_AT_ONCE_9_23_26.md). 60 mini bosses, each
handing you a VERB, parsed from records/BOHEMIA_THE_BOSS_LADDER_v7_8_7_26.md. Combat is
ROGUE FABLE 4 on the beat at 120 BPM, always against a GROUP, ON HOUSE TILES (A COMBAT TILE IS A HOUSE, Paolo 9/4, 9/24, 9/28: 'for the combat a tile is as big as a house'; the fight board is a piece of the city), with an automated companion. TWO SCALES, ONE GAME (Paolo 9/27, LOCKED, laws/BOHEMIA_LAW_TWO_SCALES_ONE_GAME_9_27_26.md): the 9/27 close scale (a tiny character, one cell per step, a house as many cells) WAS THE EXPLORATION WALK AND THE WALK IS DEAD (9/28); zoom out and the same world is the Battle Brothers map. AMENDED 9/28 (Paolo, 'fully committed... a revamp... pretty much like Battle Brothers', laws/BOHEMIA_LAW_THE_OVERWORLD_IS_BATTLE_BROTHERS_9_24_26.md s12): the character moving tile to tile through the city is DEAD; THE WALK'S ASSETS DRESS THE HOUSE-SIZED FIGHT TILES and 'never a fight where one tile is one sidewalk' means the fight tile is a HOUSE, not a cell (9/28, s14; the coordinator read s13 backwards once and it is reversed); the city is crossed on the map; THE MAP DRAWS AT BATTLE BROTHERS' PIXEL COUNT AS THE BARE MINIMUM, measured. THE STEP IS A HOUSE (9/15) is SUPERSEDED; A COMBAT TILE IS A HOUSE (9/4) STANDS IN FULL; the 112 px art is an asset, not the walked sprite. Batteries are the money (9/4). Everyone dresses
like a runway (9/4). EVERY PIXEL AND EVERY SOUND IS ANALOG HORROR, thought about at the source, not a filter, until the game is done (Paolo 9/20, LOCKED, laws/BOHEMIA_LAW_ANALOG_HORROR_FOR_EVERY_PIXEL_AND_EVERY_SOUND_9_20_26.md; a genre direction, never a new reference game). The game in one line, HIS WORDS 9/24: ECONOMIC APOCALYPSE BATTLE BROTHERS ON A PHONE, WITH A BETTER STORY. THE OVERWORLD IS THE BATTLE BROTHERS MAP (Paolo 9/24, an executive decision, laws/BOHEMIA_LAW_THE_OVERWORLD_IS_BATTLE_BROTHERS_9_24_26.md): the valley is crossed on a map with a party marker, tap to travel, time passes, events on the road; a place is a SETTLEMENT SCREEN (9/27 votes; 'the street is where you arrive' is dead); the fight is ROGUE FABLE 4 FIRST and Battle Brothers second, on house tiles (9/28: 'for the combat a tile is as big as a house'), with every floor tile translated from Battle Brothers with its cost and effect (Paolo 10/1, rule 59; the mound was the first effect, not the only); every chat carries a [bb ...] research line, continuously. NO DAMAGE BEFORE THE DIAL. EVERYTHING COSTS ONE. The demo is its
own link. THE GAMEPLAY VIBE IS MODDED VANILLA++ BATTLE BROTHERS, our twist, our own way, never a rip-off (Paolo 9/28). THE HOURS GO TO THE WORLD, NOT THE CHESS BOARD (Paolo 9/29: 'faster combat, more deep rich interactable buildable world'; laws/BOHEMIA_LAW_THE_FIGHT_GETS_DEEP_TUNING_AND_MODS_9_27_26.md s8): fights are shorter than Battle Brothers' 30-to-40-minute tough battles even at their toughest (9/29, his correction: a routine fight 2 to 4 minutes, a tough one never past 15; tough means enemy level, enemy gear, or your mistake), building happens inside a home base's settlement screen, the fight is under a third of playtime. RECREATE BATTLE BROTHERS WITH OUR WHOLE SWAG (Paolo 9/29): when a lane has a question about how a system works, the first answer is HOW DID BATTLE BROTHERS DO IT, from the library, then our swag; NO TWO COMBAT BOARDS ARE THE SAME, the board is cut from the map cell's terrain and district with blockers and roofs, seeded (records/BOHEMIA_THE_COMBAT_BOARD_ASSETS_WHAT_WE_HAVE_AND_WHAT_WE_NEED_9_29_26.md). BUILD IT, DON'T ASK (Paolo 9/28: 'not every atom needs my input... you kind of know what I want, so just start making it'). Paolo DECIDES, you PRODUCE, and he reads at eighth-grade level.

## THE STRUCTURE (9/4, LOCKED): ONE WORD, ONE HALL, ONE MANAGER
Paolo talks ONLY to the coordinator (the manager). Every other chat gets the one word
VAMILY and re-reads the front page of VAMILY.md every time; the rules live there. Every
sentence he says becomes a job there before the reply ends, two words per job. Lanes:
run, world, life+city, combat, character, direction (the art director), cook (the
production artist), sounds, people, factions, ui, words, economy, dynasty, animation,
eyes-and-ears, plumber (the permanent pipe fixer: small, fast, 60 on a phone, every checker honest), tuning (21, Paolo 9/27: every number a player feels, the death rule, the difficulty sliders, the origins' difficulties; one numbers table; RESEARCH ONLY from 9/28, 'big brain research... how other games do it', laws/BOHEMIA_LAW_THE_FIGHT_GETS_DEEP_TUNING_AND_MODS_9_27_26.md s7), mods (22, Paolo 9/27: mod-friendly and readable; every content kind in a data file a modder can edit, a mods/ folder at boot; RESEARCH ONLY from 9/28, same law s7), portrait (20, Paolo 9/14: the HD face matched to the body, blank faces are the defect, he speaks along per face; laws/BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_ONE_VOTE_TAB_AND_THE_PORTRAIT_CHAT_9_14_26.md, which also makes ONE VOTE TAB in the demo the only place he votes); quests is RESEARCH ONLY (Paolo 9/27: 'I don't want a single thing from the quest chat implemented', it continuously mines the 152-quest library, laws/BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_QUESTS_IS_RESEARCH_ONLY_9_27_26.md); the lab is retired; RUN owns the demo into a friend's hands (9/5, laws/BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_THE_DEMO_IN_HANDS_AND_THE_PLUMBER_9_5_26.md). ## HOW PAOLO WORKS
- Voice-to-text stream of consciousness. Transcription garbles constantly.
  Decipher intent; NEVER take a garbled word literally or treat it as a new term.
- He never digs in files. Present everything; never tell him to go find something.
- Direct, casual, swears freely, zero fluff. Never use em dashes anywhere.
- ONE question max per response, bolded. He answers from farthest-back first.
  AMENDED 8/4 (LOCKED): questions come ONE AT A TIME from a visible queue,
  each with a thorough researched explanation and TWO OR THREE CONCLUSIONS
  (A/B/C) he picks from with one letter. REALISM FIRST: the realistic option
  leads and wins by default; realism is sacrificed only for fun/addicting
  gameplay or genuine interest, and that trade is HIS. The game's identity:
  "the most realistic economic crash simulator, but fun." Full law:
  laws/BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_REALISM_FIRST_AND_THE_QUESTION_FORMAT_8_4_26.md
- NO CALENDAR TALK (Paolo 9/5, LOCKED): "why do you keep referring to it as days,
  yesterday... the action that happened like 10 minutes ago... yesterday, the day and
  tomorrow always confuse me." To him the work is ONE continuous stream; the calendar
  date changing means nothing. NEVER say yesterday, today, tomorrow, overnight, this
  morning, or "day N" to him. Say "since your last VAMILY", "this round", "last round",
  "an hour ago", "the round before". A research unit is a ROUND, not a day (the files
  keep their DAY names; the words on his screen do not). Dates stay in commits, laws
  and records, which are for the machine.
- TALK TO HIM LIKE A PERSON (Paolo 8/24, LOCKED): "every time the chats try to
  talk to me [it's college] level language... can we still find a way to ask
  EIGHTH GRADE READING about the development... I want to repeat this." EVERY
  REPLY TO HIM is eighth-grade reading level. Short sentences. Plain words. No
  bare file paths, function names or gate names in the body (they go in the proof
  line). Numbers over adjectives. Lead with the answer. Shorter overall. THE TEST:
  would a smart fifteen-year-old who has never seen this codebase understand every
  sentence? Records, laws and commits stay detailed -- they are for the machine.
  This is about the words on HIS screen. Full law:
  laws/BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_TALK_TO_HIM_LIKE_A_PERSON_8_24_26.md
- NEVER ASK HIM A TECHNICAL OR PRIORITISATION QUESTION (Paolo 8/15, LOCKED):
  "don't be fucking asking me technical nerdy questions like this, bro. I'm stupid
  as fuck... look online to see what you should do first... what great Studios do
  first." He is the creative director; THE RUNNING ORDER IS MINE. Banned in any
  wording: which of two engineering items comes next, which lane/session owns
  something, anything named by a codename/file/gate/backlog row, anything
  answerable by reading the repo or BY RESEARCH. THE TEST: could I answer this
  myself with the repo, the laws, or a search? Then it is not a question, it is
  work I have not done. SECOND TEST: have I already written down what I think the
  answer is? Then I am seeking approval, which EVERYTHING IS A THUMB killed.
  The WHAT I NEED FROM YOU block has a correct empty state -- "Nothing, I'm good"
  -- and the pull to fill it is what manufactures these. Still legitimate: IDENTITY
  /NAMES he reserved, a genuine creative fork about the GAME in plain words, and
  anything he asked to see. Full law:
  laws/BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_NEVER_ASK_HIM_TECHNICAL_QUESTIONS_8_15_26.md
  Gate: reply_contract_gate.js
- When he corrects something: fix it immediately, root cause, move on.
- Ship A LOT per turn. Small timid turns are a standing complaint.
- END EVERY RESPONSE with, in this exact order, the LAST two blocks on screen:
  **WHAT I NEED FROM YOU** (the decisions blocking me, numbered, each answerable
  in a word; "Nothing, I'm good" if none), and then the TWO-SENTENCE plain-English
  bottom line (Paolo 7/25, LOCKED): sentence 1 = what you just did, sentence 2 =
  what he should do with it and why it matters. No jargon, not a big deal.
  (The play link, when one ships, still goes on its own last line after.)
- NAME THE TAB (Paolo 7/28, LOCKED): "I need you to always tell me what tab I can find this shit in".
  EVERY mention of something he can look at names THE TAB —
  RUN / CHARACTER / CLOTHES / ANIMATION / RIG / COMBAT / MUSIC / CITY / MAP /
  SLICE / LIFE — in plain words, every time. Not the file, not the path, not "the
  judge page". If it is not in a tab, say "NOT IN A TAB YET" in those words: a
  thing he cannot reach does not exist to him. The link is the door, the tab is
  the room, and he needs both. Full law + gate: laws/BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_NAME_THE_TAB_7_28_26.md
  BOTTOM-UP (Paolo 7/26, LOCKED): he reads from the bottom of his screen, so
  anything he has to scroll up for does not exist. The ask and the TLDR are the
  last things he sees, every single turn. A question he cannot find is a question
  you did not ask. Full contract: laws/BOHEMIA_AUTONOMY_DOCTRINE_7_26_26.md sec 3.

## LORE YAP SESSIONS (no code involved — a first-class session type)
Paolo will open sessions purely to talk: lore, laws, the world, the three arcs.
Engage fully as a conversation. Your job in these: PULL HOLES. Gut-punch
questions that could break the lore are how it gets airtight — test his ideas
against the full canon (cite the actual addendum, newest-date-wins) and against
real science, economics, human behavior, and history, because everything in
Bohemia must be grounded in the real. Never add lore he did not confirm. Every
design decision carries a life lesson underneath without the game preaching it.
The moment something LOCKS mid-conversation, write the addendum and commit it
the same turn, then keep talking. One bold question max, always.

## SHIP FLOW (Paolo 7/17/26, standing law; AMENDED 7/25/26)
- A finished update MERGES TO MAIN THE SAME TURN, by Claude, without asking.
  Paolo never clicks merge buttons.
- NO PULL REQUESTS. EVER. (Paolo 7/25/26, LOCKED, amends the 7/17 "PRs exist
  for the record only" clause, which is now DEAD.) He opened #10 off a session
  badge and landed on a week-old merged ragdoll PR: "it's so annoying." The
  session branch name is REUSED across sessions, so every PR ever opened on it
  stays badged to every future session on that name -- the badge is always
  stale and always points at somebody else's old work. The commit message and
  the records/ file ARE the record; a PR adds nothing and costs him a wrong
  turn every time he taps it. Commit straight to main. Never call
  create_pull_request. (GitHub cannot delete the old ones -- they are permanent
  history. Nothing to clean up; just stop making them.)
- ONE GATE PASS PER SHIP (Paolo 7/25/26: "it seems like it takes double the
  amount of time fr" -- he was right, and it was self-inflicted). The old flow
  ran the full ~95s suite, THEN cherry-picked onto a fresh origin/main, THEN
  ran the whole suite again, plus three pushes. That is double the wall clock
  for one ship. THE FLOW:
    1. `git fetch origin main` and branch from it BEFORE starting work.
    2. Do the work. Run the full suite ONCE, at the end.
    3. `git fetch origin main` again. If main has NOT moved, push straight to
       main -- the gates you already ran are still valid, do not re-run them.
    4. ONLY if main moved: rebase onto it and re-run the suite (that second run
       is now earning its keep -- it is verifying a real merge, not re-verifying
       your own unchanged tree).
    5. Push the same SHA to the session branch. One gate pass, one deploy.
- WHAT PAGES PUBLISHES IS NOT THE WHOLE REPO (8/6/26). Pages failed THREE commits
  in a row -- thirty minutes then timeout -- because the build was copying all
  496 MB when the product is the 106 MB in slices/. `_config.yml` now publishes
  slices/ + engine/ + records/target (the only folders a slice actually loads from)
  and NOTHING is deleted. If a new slice ever loads from another folder, add that
  folder to _config.yml or the page 404s in production while working on disk.
  Gate: pages_publish_gate.js. The push working is NOT the site working -- that is
  the whole reason this was invisible for three commits.
- Every turn that ships to main ends with the play link as the LAST LINE of
  the reply, always: https://paolosarn.github.io/bohemia/slices/BOHEMIA_ALPHA_0_9.html
  (GitHub Pages auto-redeploys main in ~2 minutes; the link never changes.)
- BUILD STAMP + DEPLOY VERIFY (7/20, after "I didn't see nothing new" twice):
  (1) every ship UPDATES #buildstamp in the alpha's front splash (date-letter +
  the headline, e.g. "BUILD 7/20a · SHUFFLE ANIMS") so Paolo can SEE which
  build he is on; the gate checks the stamp exists. (2) pushing main is NOT
  shipped: parallel-session push storms make GitHub Pages CANCEL in-flight
  builds, so the live site can lag many pushes behind.
  AMENDED 8/6/26 -- THE CANCELLING IS FIXED AND THE WORKFLOW TO WATCH HAS CHANGED.
  Measured 8/6: the lanes push to main about every THIRTEEN MINUTES and a build
  takes longer than that, so under GitHub's built-in builder a build could NEVER
  finish -- five in a row cancelled, over an hour, zero successes. That is not a
  delay to wait out, it is a deadlock. .github/workflows/pages.yml now deploys
  with `cancel-in-progress: false`, so a second push QUEUES behind the running
  deploy instead of killing it. Nothing about how anybody pushes had to change.
  SO: after pushing, check the **`pages`** workflow (GitHub MCP actions_list,
  resource_id 'pages.yml') until a run whose sha CONTAINS your content concludes
  SUCCESS -- only then is the link true. Do NOT read "pages build and deployment"
  any more; it still fires and still fails and it is now NOISE, not a symptom.
  *** CORRECTED 9/22 (coordinator, records/BOHEMIA_TWO_DEPLOYS_RACE_9_22_26.md): IT IS NOT
  NOISE ANY MORE. Since about 9/21 GitHub's own "pages build and deployment" (Jekyll,
  reading _config.yml) SUCCEEDS in ~80 s on every push and RACES the `pages` workflow;
  whichever finishes last is the live site. The Jekyll build publishes NO records/ and NO
  *.json (the exclude list), so when it wins the VOTE tab's registry 404s ("THE LIST DID
  NOT LOAD", Paolo 9/22) and the demo is the committed cut, not the fresh one. Mitigation
  shipped: `include:` in _config.yml forces the registry into the Jekyll build. THE REAL
  FIX IS THE REPO SETTING, Paolo's click: Settings -> Pages -> Source: GitHub Actions. Until
  then a deploy is only true when the `pages` run finished LAST. ***
  *** 9/23: PAOLO FLIPPED IT ("Okay i did it"). Verified on the coordinator's next push (records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_FLIPPED_PAGES_TO_ACTIONS_9_23_26.md): if that record says the legacy builder still fired, this line is wrong and the race is still on. VERIFIED minutes later: three pushes, zero legacy runs. ONE builder, pages.yml; a deploy is true when its own run is SUCCESS; 'finished last' is dead. ***
  Confirm containment with `git merge-base --is-ancestor <your-sha> <deployed-sha>`
  rather than eyeballing it -- a later sha usually carries your content, and that
  is the run that counts.
  And the site publishes slices/ + engine/ + records/target ONLY (_config.yml).
  Add a folder to the config AND the workflow's copy list together, or
  pages_publish_gate.js goes red -- it binds the two lists so neither can drift.

## ONE-LINK LAW (Paolo 7/18/26, LOCKED — he was furious about "?v=arms")
- There is ONE universal alpha URL and it NEVER changes, for ANY session:
  https://paolosarn.github.io/bohemia/slices/BOHEMIA_ALPHA_0_9.html
- NEVER append a cache-buster query string (?v=..., ?t=..., anything). Paolo sees
  the URL. A changing URL reads as a different game and it enrages him. The plain
  canonical URL is the only thing that ever gets pasted, every turn, every session.
- Freshness is handled by the machine, not the URL: slices/sw.js is an always-fresh
  service worker (network-first, registered in the alpha head) so the plain link
  always serves the newest deploy. That is why the query string is not just banned
  but UNNEEDED. If a phone still shows stale once, the fix is ONE hard refresh to
  bootstrap the worker — never a new link.
- ONE ALPHA, ONE LINK: animation, city/streets, music, characters all live in (or
  are reached from) the single alpha file. No session ships its own separate link
  (no CURRENT_SLICE link, no per-feature page) as "the build." Parallel work folds
  into the alpha (e.g. the SLICE tab) — the surface Paolo taps is always the alpha.

## THE HANDOFF FILE
`00_START_HERE_NEXT_SESSION.md` at repo root: read it immediately after this
file, every session. It is the live state: where we are, what is in flight,
what is pending Paolo. There is only ever ONE, it always has this exact name so
it sorts first and can never be missed, and every working session REWRITES it
before ending. Old handoffs are not archived as separate files; git history is
the archive.
AMENDED 9/13 (coordinator, from PLUMBER's measurement 5f9a7498: 93 commits deleted
another lane's newest block, 80 blocks lost, because a lane reads the file at the
start of a round and writes the whole file back an hour later): the START file
stays the door and the index, but EACH LANE'S BLOCK LIVES IN handoffs/<LANE>.md,
one file per lane, written only by that lane, once PLUMBER [handoff cut] lands.
Until then: RE-READ THE HANDOFF IMMEDIATELY BEFORE YOU WRITE IT, never from the
copy you read at the start of your round; the handoff gate refuses a commit that
deletes a block HEAD carries.

## TRUTH HIERARCHY (the answer to "addendum on top of addendum — will it know?")
Nothing knows automatically. Currency is BUILT, in this order:
1. **CLAUDE.md** — how to work (this file)
2. **BOHEMIA_GDD_v5 + the LAWS MASTERS + STATE_OF_PLAY** — consolidated current truth
3. **Addenda** — on ANY conflict, the NEWEST DATE WINS. The map is
   `BOHEMIA_CANON_INDEX` (regenerate with `python3 gates/bohemia_canon_index.py`
   the same turn any addendum lands). Consult it BEFORE citing an addendum.
4. **/archive** — superseded files (registry: bohemia_superseded.txt). History,
   never current. When an addendum overrides another, the old one moves to
   /archive THE SAME TURN, with a registry line saying what replaced it.
A contradiction between two live files is a BUG, not an interpretation choice:
fix it if mechanical, flag it [PENDING Paolo] if canon-level. The 7/16 graveyard
sweep found the laws master instructing a dead palette — that class of rot is
what this hierarchy exists to kill.
STANDING JOB: periodically fold addenda into the GDD/laws masters and archive
the folded (the GDD v5 consolidation pattern). Piles rot; masters stay clean.

## PARALLEL SESSIONS (one-alpha law, repo form — AMENDED by Paolo 7/19/26)
Every session BUILDS THE ALPHA. That is the point: different parts of the game,
one build, they mesh. The rule is ONE SYSTEM, ONE SESSION: no two sessions may
edit the SAME system at the same time (two sessions both editing clothing =
danger; wardrobe + LIFE + COMBAT in parallel = the design). Stay inside your
session's systems; a rebase conflict inside the alpha means a boundary was
crossed -- stop and check before pushing.

- THE FEED ON THE CITY SCREEN (Paolo 9/4, LOCKED): "when it's in zoomed out city
  mode I want part of the UI to show a phone screen and the social posts just
  scrolling... our achievements or auto generated posts... you'll learn more about
  the world and you'll see the quests you've done." In CITY mode a phone screen on
  the UI scrolls one feed of three kinds of post: what you did (the deed ledger,
  which exists), what the world did (faction and territory events), and

  THE-FEED-ON-THE-CITY-SCREEN, WORLD THE-FEED-STREAM, WORDS Q15.

## THE AUTONOMY DOCTRINE (Paolo 7/26/26, LOCKED — binds EVERY session)
Read laws/BOHEMIA_AUTONOMY_DOCTRINE_7_26_26.md and follow it exactly. The
short form: the FIRST word of a new session names its lane (run/world/city/
combat/character/animation/quests/people/sound/ui/direction/cook/words/economy/dynasty/eyes-and-ears/coordinator; the reference lab was retired 9/4) and means GO; after that his entire
vocabulary is "go" / "verdicts in" / "status" —
any other word from him is a RULING to record, never a discussion to have.
On "go": run THE GO PROCEDURE (resume mid-flight work, else pop your lane's
top unblocked item from BOHEMIA_BACKLOG.md; [PENDING] blocks nothing; over
the verdict-queue cap you do only non-cook work). EVERY reply to Paolo ends
with: a 3-line plain-English TLDR (he does not read code), a numbered JUDGE
THIS list (side-by-side anchors, or "Nothing to judge"), any DID-NOT-DECIDE
pendings, and the proof line. Verdicts: APPROVE unlocks volume, CBB ships
frozen, KILL graveyards with post-mortem. STALE UNJUDGED IS DEAD (bulk
silence is a verdict — laws/BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_UNJUDGED_IS_DEAD_7_26_26.md).
Forbidden shortcuts are pre-named in the doctrine; verification is never
self-attestation. He thumbs and he playtests; everything else is yours.

## READ THIS FRONT PAGE EVERY SINGLE TIME YOU HEAR THE WORD VAMILY
Not once. Every time. Rules change on this page and nowhere else, so a chat that
remembers last week's rules is wrong. Paolo never pastes anything; he types the
one word, and this page is the briefing.

0. VAMILY is a keyword. It has nothing to do with families or dynasties. It means:
   read this page, find your section below, do your job from it.
1. Paolo talks ONLY to the coordinator (00 MASTER COORDINATOR, the manager). Every
   other chat gets the one word and nothing else. Never ask him anything. A ruling
   you need goes in your handoff block in 00_START_HERE_NEXT_SESSION.md as
   [PENDING Paolo]; the coordinator carries it to him.
2. FIND YOUR SECTION by this chat's number and name (the list is right below). A
   fresh chat with no name takes the first line marked UNCLAIMED, writes CLAIMED on
   it, commits, and that is its role for life. AS OF 9/14: the one UNCLAIMED line is
   20 PORTRAIT (Paolo 9/14: "we might need to open up a new chat for the portrait");
   PLUMBER is claimed. AS OF 9/20 THERE ARE NO UNCLAIMED LINES: 20 PORTRAIT is CLAIMED
   (session portrait-vamily-yke55s, Paolo opened the chat 9/20). A brand-new chat with
   no name asks the coordinator instead of taking a line.
3. READ YOUR SECTION'S MODE AND STATE LINES FIRST. STATE says what is built, what
   is not, and what nobody has checked, so you know what you do not know.
4. Every job carries a TWO-WORD label in [brackets], for him. The name after it is
   the job. A BB- name's full text is that row in BOHEMIA_BACKLOG.md; any other
   job's one-line brief here IS the job.
5. IF YOU ALREADY HOLD A CLAIMED JOB, VAMILY MEANS CONTINUE IT, from where your
   handoff block says you stopped. A job takes as many rounds as it takes; nobody
   expects one round. Otherwise take the FIRST line marked OPEN in your section,
   change it to CLAIMED <date> <session>, commit and push BEFORE you start.
6. MODE: BUILD means build it, prove it on the real surface (the walked city and
   the demo, on a phone if you can), re-cut the demo, run your lane's gates, then
   change the line to SHIPPED <date> <commit> and push. Mark SHIPPED only when the
   job's own ship test is met; a half-done job marked SHIPPED is worse than an open
   one, never rush to close a line.
   MODE: RESEARCH means DO NOT IMPLEMENT: one research round on the question (the records call it a "day"; it is one VAMILY, not a calendar day, and you never call it a day to Paolo), both
   angles (the best games ever made, and the real world), one finding that proves
   us wrong, measured against our repo, a written record, test material tagged
   draft:true in a bank file never in the game, a ROUTED section; mark SHIPPED
   with the record path.
   MODE: PARKED means nobody touches it until Paolo reopens it.
7. Every mechanic is 120 BPM friendly or it is not done. A row is not shipped
   until it is in the walked surface AND the demo.
8. STANDING DUTIES, every round: VAMILY first; play it before you call it shipped;
   his bugs beat your queue; run your gates, never ship red; rewrite your handoff
   block before you end. ADDED 9/13: if your diff touches engine/, rebuild the two
   derived slices (the RUN_CURRENT slice and the demo) in the same commit; PLUMBER
   found the RUN slice drifting +45/-6 behind two engine ships that never rebuilt it,
   and the freshness gate was red for everybody because of it. ADDED 9/13 (PLUMBER 5f9a7498 measured 93 commits that deleted another lane's newest handoff block, 80 blocks lost, 42 still missing, and it was never the rebases: a lane reads the file at the start of its round and writes the whole file back an hour later): RE-READ THE HANDOFF IMMEDIATELY BEFORE YOU WRITE IT, never from the copy you read at the start of your round. The handoff gate now refuses a commit that deletes a block HEAD carries; tools/bohemia_handoff_recover.js puts eaten blocks back.
9. END EVERY ROUND by replying to him with the two-word label and one short line:
   "continuing, about N of M" or "shipped" or "queue empty".
10. Only the coordinator adds jobs here (one exception: EYES AND EARS may add a
    single [eyes: two words] bounce-back line on a defect it found in a SHIPPED
    item). Lanes change status words and nothing else. The SHIPPED lines are the
    history.
Full law: laws/BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_THE_VAMILY_WORD_9_4_26.md and
laws/BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_THE_CENTRAL_CHAT_9_4_26.md

11. A SHIPPED LINE KEEPS THE RULING IT ANSWERED (coordinator 9/12, from EYES E16). Measured: an OPEN line cites one of Paolo's rulings 34% of the time, a SHIPPED line only 12%, because the line gets rewritten as a result summary when it lands and his words go with it. From now, when you mark a line SHIPPED you keep its [two-word label] AND the "Paolo <date>" citation exactly as the OPEN line carried them; you may ADD the sha and one result clause, you never delete the ruling. The link between what he said and what got built is the point of this board.
12. A DEPENDENCY ON A LINE IS A PREMISE, NOT A GATE (coordinator 9/13, from FACTIONS [tracks read]: "the named blocker was not the blocker, sixth row running"). When a line says "after X" or "with X", the lane MEASURES FIRST whether X is actually needed and builds if it is not. Six rows in a row shipped without the blocker the coordinator named. Nothing on this board waits on a line the coordinator wrote; only on a measurement the lane made.
13. "I RAN THE SUITE" MEANS TWO THINGS AND ONLY TWO (coordinator 9/13, from three lanes measuring the same wall: 331 of 603 gates NEVER RAN in a 45-minute budget, 56 of 372 that did run were red, the floor is 71 minutes; records/BOHEMIA_COORDINATOR_SWING_HOW_BIG_SHOPS_RUN_A_SUITE_THAT_CANNOT_FINISH_9_13_26.md). (a) You ran the PRE-PUSH PASS, the gates that read the files in your diff, and it was green. (b) You read THE SUITE LINE, the last full run PLUMBER posts on this front page (sha, ran, green, red, never ran, flaked), and you name which of its reds are yours. *** ROUND 5, 9/18 -- THE WALK NUMBER WAS NOT A FRAME RATE. IT WAS A PLAYER PRESSED AGAINST A WALL. (PLUMBER, row [sixty fps]. Record: records/BOHEMIA_THE_WALK_WAS_A_PLAYER_STUCK_AGAINST_A_WALL_9_18_26.md) ***
 LAST ROUND LEFT TWO BUDGETS OUT OF THE CLAMP because the record and the gate disagreed about the same metric by 6.3x (8.8 fps against 55.8) and 2.5x. Reconciling them was the named next line. Both are now closed and the cause was one bug in this lane's own instrument.
 REPRODUCED ON DEMAND, one boot each, everything else identical: skipFirstMinute=true gives a settled walk of 60.0 fps over 110 cells; skipFirstMinute=false gives 8.8 fps over THREE CELLS. 8.8 is the record's number exactly. THE CAUSE: every walk in the instrument pressed the same direction, including the settled one that runs AFTER a sixty-second first-minute walk the same way. So the settled sample measured a player who had been walking north for over a minute and was against something. IT WAS NEVER A FRAME RATE: the good-bursts rate was 60.2 in BOTH runs. The game drew at sixty the whole time; one player was walking and the other was stuck.
 THE VALIDITY FLOOR WAS TOO WEAK TO CATCH IT. The instrument already said "a sample that did not move is not a slow sample, it is a broken one" and the rule was right; the THRESHOLD asked "did he move at all" and one cell passed. Measured: a walking player covers 110-123 cells in 6 s, a stuck one covers 3. The floor is now TWO CELLS PER SECOND OF HOLD, ten times under a healthy walk and four times over a stuck one, and an invalid sample carries WHY in its own body.
 FIXED AND MEASURED BOTH WAYS: before 60.0 fps/110 cells against 8.8 fps/3 cells; after 58.3/110 against 50.9/110. A 6.3x disagreement became 1.15x. In the refreshed record the walk reads 57.1 fps against the gate's live 60.4, and main thread 20.6% against 17.9% -- SAME ROOT CAUSE, no separate hunt needed, because a player against a wall barely draws so his frame rate and his thread cost both read low.
 SO BOTH LINES ARE BACK IN THE CLAMP and notClampedOnPurpose is now EMPTY. Six budget lines clamped instead of four: fight 10->47.81, walking 6->40.77, main thread 56->33, beats missed 9->4, alpha walk 6->41.66, alpha beats 11->4. Every held line sits between 1.15x and 1.60x of what the build does, against a guard that fails anything over 2x. Excluding them last round with their numbers written down was the right call while they disagreed and the wrong thing to keep once they did not.
 THE GATE IS 38 PASSED / 3 FAILED (it was 36/3 last round and 32/3 when this row started). ONE LINE FOR RUN, THIRD ROUND RUNNING: all three reds are the same bug, #daycard is inset:0 and sits over all eight direction buttons on boot, so time to first play cannot be measured on either surface.

*** ROUND 4, 9/16 -- THE SPEED GATE WOULD HAVE ACCEPTED A SIX-TIMES REGRESSION IN THE FIGHT, AND NOW IT WILL NOT. (PLUMBER, row [sixty fps]. Record: records/BOHEMIA_A_BUDGET_THAT_ACCEPTS_A_SIX_TIMES_REGRESSION_9_16_26.md) ***
 THE HOLE: the fight budget the gate held was 10 fps while the build delivered 60. A 5.7x regression on the pillar mechanic would have passed green. Last round named this and refused to half-fix it; this round measured what a fix needs.
 THE CAUSE, MEASURED IN TWO PARTS. (1) A history entry carries no build identity, so a sample from a build with a real bug anchors the budget straight across the fix: fightLo went 17.6, 25, 15.4, 15.6, then 54.3 the moment somebody re-measured. (2) THE BIGGER ONE: the 40% spread that justified "worst of six refreshes" was measured on ONE metric and applied to ALL of them. Four passes of one unchanged tree: bytes 0.0%, beats missed 0.0%, THE FIGHT 0.5%, boot blocking 4.2%, walking 4.4%, main thread 8.3%. Bytes literally do not move and the fight varies by half a percent, and they were being given the headroom of a metric that swings 40%.
 THE FIX: keep worst-of-history, then CLAMP each line so it cannot sit further from what the build does today than that metric's OWN measured spread plus a stated margin. The margin is 0.25 and it is grounded, not picked: three times the largest spread on any valid metric across six passes. A floor on my own rule: fewer than three samples is not a spread, so the clamp is skipped and the record says so on its face. MOVED: fightFps 10 -> 47.81, beatMissed 9 -> 3, alphaWalkFps 6 -> 10, alphaBeatMissed 11 -> 4. The live gate now reads the fight at 60 against a budget of 47.7.
 *** THEN MY OWN FIX WENT RED AND I DID NOT WIDEN THE MARGIN TO HIDE IT. *** Clamping main-thread-busy gave budget 9 against a live 15.8. Widening the margin until it went green would have loosened the fight's clamp too, and the fight is the one that needed fixing. So I compared EVERY held line's record value against the gate's own live value on the same tree: fight 60 vs 60 agree, bytes agree exactly, beats 2 vs 2.6 close, MAIN THREAD 6.4% vs 15.8% (2.5x apart), WALKING 8.8 fps vs 55.8 fps (6.3x apart). TWO OF THE LINES THIS GATE HOLDS ARE DERIVED FROM NUMBERS THAT DO NOT DESCRIBE WHAT THE GATE MEASURES. Both keep their old budget; reconciling the two walk samples is its own job and is the next line of this row.
 AND A RED THAT BLINDED THE WHOLE GATE: the record-completeness block ended in a flat abort, so the moment any one line went red the other thirty-odd checks never ran. Measured: a card over the pad made first play unmeasurable and a gate with 37 working checks reported 18 passed / 1 failed and said nothing else. Now it gives up only if the record is structurally unusable. Same verdict, same exit code, but one blocked measurement costs one line instead of the whole page.
 ONE LINE FOR RUN, AND IT HAS GOT WORSE SINCE LAST ROUND: all three remaining reds are the same bug. #daycard is inset:0 and sits over all eight direction buttons on boot. LAST ROUND THE DEMO STILL GOT THROUGH ONCE AT 18,027 ms; THIS ROUND NO PASS ON EITHER SURFACE REACHED A FIRST STEP AT ALL, so time-to-first-play cannot be measured on this build. I let that go red rather than carry the last number that happened to get through. Gate was 32 passed / 3 failed before this round and is 36 / 3 now.

*** ROUND 3, 9/15 -- THE FIGHT RUNS AT SIXTY ON THIS BOX AND AT SEVEN ON A PHONE. (PLUMBER, row [sixty fps]. Record: records/BOHEMIA_THE_FIGHT_IS_SIXTY_HERE_AND_SEVEN_ON_A_PHONE_9_15_26.md) ***
 THE SPEED INSTRUMENT HAS MEASURED A PHONE-SHAPED CPU SINCE 9/5 AND THREW IT AWAY EVERY TIME. It defaults to both 1x and 4x, but the refresh command written in its own record pinned it to --cpu 1. So every speed number this fleet has ever quoted describes a machine several times faster than his phone. FIXED: the refresh no longer pins the throttle, the record now carries a phone-shaped block, and the gate PRINTS it beside the 1x numbers and FAILS if a future record has none.
 ONE REFRESH, TWO REPEATS, ONE WINDOW; the throttle proved real in the same run by the yardstick (31.75 ms at 1x against 136.7 ms at 4x):
   the fight                57.2 fps here   ->    7.1 fps on a phone-shaped CPU (alpha: 60.1 -> 9.4)
   boot blocked the thread  19,530 ms       ->   71,758 ms, worst single block 7,080 -> 26,532 ms
   beats LATE once settled      9.9 %       ->     31.6 %, and 8.3% SWALLOWED WHOLE
   THE WALKED CITY ALONE     58.5 fps       ->    58.4 fps
 *** READ THE LAST ROW. THE WALKED CITY DOES NOT CARE ABOUT THE THROTTLE AT ALL. So what collapses on a phone is NOT the world and NOT the walking. It is THE FIGHT (an 8x fall) and THE SHELL BOOT. That is a much narrower target than "the game is slow", and it is only visible because the control is measured at both rates in one run.
 AND THE 120 BPM LAW ON A PHONE: one beat in twelve never happens. Nobody had that number because nobody kept a throttled pass.
 THE OLD RECORD WAS WRONG IN THE BUILD'S FAVOUR: it said the fight ran at 16.2 fps with 7,424 draw calls a frame. It is 57.2 fps at 4. SOMEBODY FIXED THE FIGHT AND NOBODY RE-MEASURED FOR NINE DAYS. A stale measurement is reassurance about a build that no longer exists, in both directions.
 A DEFECT IN THIS LANE'S OWN GATE, NAMED NOT HALF-FIXED: the fight budget the gate holds is 10 fps and the build does 57, so A 5.7x REGRESSION WOULD PASS GREEN. The budget is "worst case across the last six refreshes", whose own argument is explicitly about ONE UNCHANGED TREE, but a history entry carries no build identity, so a sample from the broken build anchors the budget across a real fix. A new rule needs its own measurement of the real spread; inventing a clamp factor at the end of a long round is how a gate gets a number nobody can defend. NEXT LINE OF THIS ROW (rule 6).
 ONE LINE FOR RUN, named not fixed: the speed gate has two reds and they are ONE BUG. #daycard is inset:0 and SITS OVER ALL EIGHT DIRECTION BUTTONS ON BOOT, so a driven thumb has nothing to press and the alpha never reaches its first step.  HE MEETS THE WORST PART OF THE GAME FIRST, AND THE BOX WAS HIDING IT. This container is not a handset; every fps number this fleet ever posted was taken on a machine several times faster than his phone. The walk now takes a CPU throttle, and a ladder was run in one window:
   1x   door 13.4 s   58.4 fps over the walk   53.3 fps in the first 15 s   worst stall 1.2 s
   4x   door 52.9 s   53.4 fps over the walk    9.8 fps in the first 15 s   worst stall 8.8 s
   6x   door 79.4 s   34.9 fps over the walk   11.0 fps in the first 15 s   worst stall 8.1 s
 At 4x, second by second: 4, 8, 6, 4, 6, 8, 7, 10, 7, 7, 9, 7, 5, 2 -- THEN 57, 56, 57. THIRTEEN SECONDS AT ABOUT TEN FRAMES A SECOND, THEN IT SNAPS TO FIFTY-SEVEN. The 6x run has the same shape. At 1x the dip is three seconds and small, which is why nobody has ever seen it. A whole-walk average buries it completely, and thirteen seconds is a sixth of his five minutes and the first thing he touches. THIS IS NOT MINE TO FIX: it lives in the demo shell's boot and the city frame's first paint. ONE LINE FOR RUN and ONE FOR LIFE+CITY.
 AND HIS THEORY, NAMED: the door opens after 3 files; then 30 more files and 75.9 MB stream in behind him while he plays, the last landing 227 s after the door (at 4x: 31 files, 80.9 MB, last at 311 s, past the end of his five minutes). NEW GATE, in the suite as LOADING IN PLAY: gates/loading_during_play_gate.js, a ratchet pinned off two of its own runs (63.9 MB, 27 files in a 75 s window), four floors before any ceiling, GREEN 6/0.
 WHAT I COULD NOT CHECK, SAID OUT LOUD: the test server sets no cache headers and this container's network policy blocks the live site, so whether a real browser re-downloads those chunks or reads them from disk is UNKNOWN from here. Either way the bytes are parsed on the main thread while he plays.
 AND A TEST I BUILT AND THREW AWAY BEFORE IT REACHED THIS PAGE: I tried to prove his theory by splitting the walk into loading seconds and quiet seconds. Two ways of lining up the load clock with the frame clock gave two answers off the SAME run (45.3 vs 55.3, gap 10.0; and 51.7 vs 55.4, gap 3.7). A test that changes its verdict with its arithmetic is not evidence, so it is deleted. The second-by-second curve above needs no alignment at all.

73a. THE SUN TEST, CORRECTED BY THE MEASUREMENTS (coordinator 10/4, from COMBAT 2e62bd5 and COMBAT TWO 0126ef29): adding a flat 25 percent white to both sides of a 3 to 1 pair always drops it near 2 to 1 (the maths, not the art), so UNDER THE GLARE the floor is 2 to 1 for a lit tile against an unlit one and for a man against his ground; AT REST the floors stay 3 to 1 and 4.5 to 1 for words. A man is counted WITH his one-pixel rim (cold at night, dark by day), because the rim is how a figure reads on a bright glass; COMBAT's night rim stays and a day rim is COMBAT's next leg on [struck down]'s round or earlier. The ground's 20 percent median stays. COMBAT's night sits at 64 percent of the day's light and 3.13 to 1 lit against unlit at rest (passes); COMBAT TWO's settlement nights pass the plain floor and read 2.2 to 2.4 under glare (passes 73a). EYES sourced the school page (57a03621): WCAG's 4.5 and 3 are the real criteria; DisplayMate's sunlight lab is the shape of the test; iOS Safari never exposes the light sensor, so the slider is right.
73b. THE FLOOR, MEASURED BY AN INDEPENDENT INSTRUMENT (coordinator 10/5, from EYES a699b018: real screenshots of the fight and the settlement nights measured in Python, not the page's self-report). PASSES WITH MARGIN: lit against unlit, the five HUD words (10 to 11 to 1), all six settlement nights. TWO GAPS: (1) a man never clears 3 to 1 against his ground, day or night (COMBAT's gate only checks that night stays close to day); (2) the walkable ground's median sits about four times under the literal 20 percent, day and night alike, because the boards are asphalt. RULING: the absolute 20 percent median was the wrong floor for a city of asphalt and is DROPPED; what stands is NIGHT KEEPS AT LEAST 55 PERCENT OF THE DAY'S LIGHT on the same board (COMBAT's 64), the ratios of 73a (3 to 1 at rest, 2 to 1 under glare, words 4.5), and the man's floor is met WITH his rim: COMBAT adds the DARK DAY RIM and a gate leg that measures a man against his ground at rest and under glare, day and night (pull PLUMBER [sun gate]'s leg into the fight's suite, rule 74). EYES' instrument (tools/bohemia_eyes_night_in_the_sun.js) is the measure of record.

77. TILES ARE LEGOS (PAOLO 10/5: 'the tiles aren't speaking to each other, the street tiles and the freeway tiles look like dog shit... what's facing north, what's facing east and west... these things should conjoin easily like Legos... vibe code dog shit'). Every ground tile has FOUR TYPED EDGES (what runs out of each side: road with its lane lines, sidewalk, curb, lot, wall, water, nothing) and may sit beside another only where the edge types match; lane lines, curbs and sidewalks continue across every seam; one compass convention written on every sheet; the street and the freeway are the first set. A gate reads every board and fails on any seam whose edge types differ or whose lines do not meet. COMBAT TWO [tiles are legos] FIRST, above everything; RUN's map blocks follow the same grammar when the painters return.
66a. THE OPENING SCREEN IS AWESOME, AND IT TAKES 40 SECONDS (PAOLO 10/5: 'the new opening screen is awesome... I feel like I gotta wait 40 seconds for this shit to load... I wish there was cool main menu music'). The title SHOWS within two seconds of the tap on a phone; the world loads behind it and NEW GAME and CONTINUE light when it is ready, the loading shown as the camera's own feed, never a bar; RUN [first load] FIRST after the origin. PLUMBER IS OPENED DEMO ONLY (rule 54c, below): [first load] cuts the bytes and measures time-to-title at 4x throttle. SOUNDS [the title's music] FIRST: a title song in analog horror from real material, the one source until NEW GAME or CONTINUE, handing to the map's song on a phrase. EVERYTHING, graphic or sound, follows the analog horror law (9/20), his words again.

THE HORROR READING (EYES E28, rule 20, STANDING; latest 10/1 on the alpha (rule 54a narrows this lane to visuals and sounds; the standing demo-cut clone was slow this round so the alpha stood in, same tool, same rules), ZERO FINDINGS AGAIN: controls all green, 0 findings, 0 unmeasured-and-unsaid; the fight was not reached on this route (R3 n/a), same known shape as every alpha-only pass. Record records/BOHEMIA_EYES_E28_HORROR_CHECK_9_21_26.json. This lane does NOT judge the tone -- DIRECTION decides taste, the bible IS the taste written down, and what makes it checkable is that every rule carries its own MEASURE)
 THREE OF THE TEN NOW HAVE A NUMBER, AND THE CUT PASSES ALL THREE. ZERO FINDINGS.
   R3  THE LONG HOLD     PASS  worst four-beat window moved 4.8% of the frame against the bible's 10% bar, 0 of 8 windows over, nothing touched (four beats at 120 BPM is 2.0 s, the bible's own window)
   R8  DIEGETIC OR DEAD  PASS  0 see-through full-frame draws on the 378x815 world canvas. The 82 full-frame draws there are ALL opaque clears, which is the frame clear every canvas game does, not an overlay
   R10 GRIME IS BAKED    PASS  0 filters and 0 composite modes on the world canvas
 THE OTHER SEVEN ARE UNMEASURED AND EACH IS NAMED WITH WHAT IT WAITS ON, which is the bible's own instruction (rule 13): R1, R2 and R7 wait on world state naming WHICH element is the wrong one; R4's night half waits on a walk that reaches night; R6 waits on a portrait appearing; R9 waits on a schedule to read; and R5 is a CSS sweep this lane already owns and can wire, the cheapest of the seven and MINE.
 *** AND THE NEAR-MISS IS THE FINDING WORTH READING. THE FIRST VERSION OF THIS INSTRUMENT REPORTED TWO FAILURES AGAINST THE BIBLE WITH EVERY CONTROL GREEN, AND BOTH WERE FALSE. *** It said 220 full-frame overlays and 2 runtime composite passes. Most of the 220 were 44x44 draws onto 44x44 SPRITE SCRATCH CANVASES -- a draw that covers a scratch canvas is not an overlay on anything. The three that really were world-sized were OPAQUE BACKGROUND FILLS, a frame clear. The 2 composites were source-atop on scratch canvases, which is sprite tinting at bake time. EVERY ROUND BEFORE THIS ONE A CONTROL CAUGHT MY ERROR; THIS TIME THE CONTROLS PASSED AND THE ERROR WAS STILL THERE, because they ask 'does a planted draw get counted' and the answer was yes. PROVING A COUNTER BITES DOES NOT PROVE IT COUNTS THE RIGHT THING -- it must also be proved pointed at the right surface. Two false accusations against another lane's bible, stopped one step from this page.

THE BEST CUT (EYES E27, rule 18d, 9/20; record records/BOHEMIA_EYES_E27_THERE_IS_NO_BETTER_CUT_9_20_26.md, raw runs records/BOHEMIA_EYES_E27_BEST_CUT_RUNS_9_20_26.jsonl)
 *** THERE IS NO BETTER CUT TO GO BACK TO, AND THE RANKING WILL NOT HOLD STILL. *** Eight RUN build stamps across two weeks, each cut by the repo's own cutter in a throwaway worktree at that sha (nothing of RUN's touched), each walked the same 90 seconds on a phone-shaped CPU with the throttle proved real in every run. TWO FULL PASSES.
   EVERY CUT IS FROZEN FOR 95.0% TO 96.6% OF ITS FIRST NINETY SECONDS. Best to worst across the whole fortnight is 1,385 ms out of 90,000, one and a half percent. AND THE ORDER REORDERS ITSELF: pass one's least-frozen was 9/15s, pass two's was 9/18g, the NEWEST. The gap between best and worst is smaller than the noise on a single cut, so the order is a coin toss, and when a ranking reorders on unchanged code the honest report is not a winner -- it is that the things being ranked are the same.
   WALKING IS BROKEN ON ALL EIGHT: a four-second held press moves 0.1% to 2.7% of the screen, dial found and pressed every time, that control green on every cut.
   AND I AM NOT NAMING A COMMIT FOR THE ONE THING THAT LOOKED LIKE A REGRESSION. Worst single freeze sat at ~33 s for the first four cuts and ~41 s for the last four, breaking between 9/15s and 9/16f. Bisecting the 55 commits there is NOT MONOTONIC (32.7, then 40.3 thirteen in, then 33.2, then 32.6, then 41.9). So I ran ONE SHA FOUR TIMES: 41,873 / 32,113 / 32,728 / 33,040 -- one run in four lands in the high mode on identical code. Then pass two proved it the other way: 9/15m went 33,019 -> 41,364 and 9/16f went 41,873 -> 33,370, two cuts swapping sides. That mode does not live in the code, and I was one step from handing RUN a commit to revert.
   SO FOR RULE 18(d): THERE IS NOTHING TO REVERT TO. Reverting buys one percent of a frozen window and throws away everything built since. The freeze is not a regression that crept in; it has been the same size the whole fortnight. If a reference is still wanted, take the NEWEST, because nothing measurably better exists behind it.
   WHAT THIS DOES NOT MEASURE, STATED: it scores loading, freezing and whether a held press moves the world. It does NOT judge pictures, so if 'closer to being able to play' was about the car, the streets or the far zoom, this says nothing about that. 90 seconds is weighted to the boot, where the freezing is; over 300 seconds the frozen share is about a third, not 96%.

THE STRANGER'S LIST (EYES E26 posts it every round; walked cold on a phone profile, observations only, never a score. Round 24, 10/1, records/BOHEMIA_EYES_E26_WALK_DEPLOY_9_14_26.json. Walked on a demo cut fresh from main: 18 things offered on the first screen (was 15, 13, 2 -- it keeps changing shape), 19 pressed, 35.6 s to first tappable thing (was 33.8 s), STILL NO FIGHT IN FIVE MINUTES at 301 s -- the oldest line on this list, still true. @thevalley (a hashtag link in the notes panel) REPEATED DEAD TWO ROUNDS RUNNING, same rigour both times (pressed twice, panel open, zero novel words or cells either round) -- A SECOND BOUNCE-BACK, below. The three roster name tags from last round's bounce-back were not on this route (not confirmed fixed, not re-confirmed dead either -- routes vary). ONE NEW DEAD, first time, named not bounced: @nightcount, same panel, same rigour. THREE BUTTONS THAT LOOK LIKE UI'S OWN FRESH SPEED PAD (II, 1x, 3x) also read dead by this test, but UI's own board row already shows that exact feature CLAIMED and NOT YET SHIPPED with its own gate RED on the 3x multiplier -- this is very likely the SAME known-unfinished work, not an independent new bug, and the walker's "novel words/cells" test may simply be the wrong instrument for a control whose only effect is a background TIME RATE, not new content; named, not bounced, until UI's own row moves. Instrument gap still open and printed every round: the walker can misread an already-open tab's correct no-op as dead (named after round 7); no alpha cross-check was run this round to confirm it did or did not misfire, so that stays open rather than cleared)
 1. THE DEMO ITSELF, UNCHANGED SHAPE: 2 things with words offered on the first screen, 6 pressed, 0 dead, ONE knock to open the door, first tappable thing 30.3 s, 0 real page errors, STILL NO FIGHT IN FIVE MINUTES -- the oldest line on this list and the only one that has never moved.
 2. *** THREE OF THE SIX NAMED CARDS ON THIS ROUND'S RESEARCH JOB ARE ALREADY GONE, AND FOR GOOD REASON. *** E23's row asks a checker to drive the conversation, offer, nightfall, haggle, fight and feed cards. Read against the real source (the child frame, not the shell -- I checked the wrong file first and caught it before publishing): OFFER's own function returns before it ever calls the card-drawing call, on purpose, guarded by a comment that says QUESTS and PEOPLE are building a mouth-and-portrait version to replace it (rule 20, A QUEST IS PEOPLE PLACES AND THINGS, NEVER A CARD). HAGGLE lives inside that same dead path. NIGHTFALL no longer opens a card at all -- rule 19a (NO POP UPS, Paolo 9/20) moved it to the phone, and the day now turns by itself behind it. Only CONVERSATION and FEED are still real, and FEED was never a card to begin with, it is the scrolled phone screen. A checker written strictly to the row's list would measure two screens while claiming six.
 3. SCHOOL: how real accessibility crawlers avoid exactly this. MobiGUITAR and ACE discover states by DRIVING from the start screen and stop when every event leads somewhere already visited -- never from a written list. Android's own Monkey tool gets 10.3% activity coverage because it presses blind to what state it is in; a fixed card list is the same mistake from the other side, pressing without knowing the game's state has moved. Round two builds the driven crawl instead of the list, reusing thumb_gate.js's addEventListener wrap and city_rail_gate.js's read-what-the-column-holds pattern rather than rebuilding either.
 4. THE HORROR CHECK, STANDING, TENTH CUT RUNNING, ZERO FINDINGS: R3 0.7% in the worst four-beat window against a 10% bar; R8 0 see-through full-frame draws; R10 0 filters and 0 composites.
 BLIND SPOTS, STATED: no browser was opened this round, MODE: SCHOOL THEN CHECK; every card-reachability claim is read from source and round two's crawl is what proves it on the glass. Fight (combat) is out of scope on purpose, a different surface with its own rows.
