# LAW BOHEMIA_LAW_THE_FIGHT_GETS_DEEP_TUNING_AND_MODS_9_27_26.md
# source: laws/BOHEMIA_LAW_THE_FIGHT_GETS_DEEP_TUNING_AND_MODS_9_27_26.md
====================================================================================================
# BOHEMIA LAW -- THE FIGHT GETS DEEP: TUNING (21) AND MODS (22) (Paolo 9/27/26, LOCKED)
# His words: records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_450_HOURS_THE_FIGHT_GETS_DEEP_9_27_26.md. Rule 36 on VAMILY.md.

## 1. DEPTH IS THE TARGET
"It took me 450 hours to feel like I mastered all of the combat mechanics." The fight is built to be MASTERED
over hundreds of hours: squad formation (who stands where on the grid, the front line and the second row,
reach in cells), gear (armour that is slightly better and FEELS it), knowledge that pays (what an enemy kind
does, what a weapon shape does), skill that develops. Rogue Fable 4 leads the speed (rule 33d); Battle
Brothers leads the DEPTH. Both at once is the whole ask: "less of a chess puzzle piece and quicker".
COMBAT [formation]: the front line, the second row, flanking and being flanked, in cells, with what each
costs; COMBAT [gambits]: the rest of the company acts on its own (FINAL FANTASY XII gambits, already the
reference for this and only this), so his turn is quick and his knowledge shows in how he set them.

## 2. DEATH, SOFTENED (default, in VOTE)
"Only a 20% chance your character can die, but if they get struck down, a debilitating injury." When a
person is STRUCK DOWN in a fight: 20% they die (buried; the company remembers, the creditor remembers);
80% they live with a DEBILITATING INJURY that takes them out of fights for 30 to 40 game days and leaves a
permanent mark (a scar, a limp, a lost eye, a stat that never comes back). "Vanilla plus Battle Brothers":
his own roster's deaths should hurt and be rare; being out for a month should be common and felt. TUNING
owns the numbers; PEOPLE owns the person (the injured stay in the company, cost their day, talk about it).

## 3. ORIGINS, DIFFICULTY, CUSTOMIZATION
- ORIGINS: the company's starting story sets rules, not just the start (Battle Brothers: the Peasant
  Militia, the Lone Wolf, the Cultists...). Ours: who you were the day the money died (the lineman's crew,
  the casino floor, the ex-cons, the nurse's ward), each at a stated DIFFICULTY. PEOPLE writes the origins
  (the people), TUNING the difficulties.
- DIFFICULTY SLIDERS: "well beyond me, you would need to optimize for that." TUNING designs them: what a
  slider moves (enemy count, pay, injury odds, the death chance itself), what it never moves (the rules of
  the grid), and the default a stranger plays at.
- CUSTOMIZATION: the face maker (HE CAN BUILD HIS OWN FACE) and the runway clothes are the character side;
  ARMOUR ATTACHMENTS (Battle Brothers' cloaks, paddings, spikes: a trade of armour vs fatigue vs a special)
  are new: CHARACTER [attachments], school then cook. Weapons: shapes and reach (rule 33i), little
  customization beyond that, by his words.

## 4. CHAT 21: TUNING (the numbers; Sonnet)
"The smallest changes in numbers mean the biggest difference... a slightly better armour makes a huge
difference... a chat dedicated to the fine-tuning of the gameplay mechanics, rewarding your own knowledge
and skill." TUNING owns every number a player FEELS: damage, armour, hit chance, fatigue, injury odds,
the death chance, costs in batteries, prices per place, the difficulty sliders, the origins' difficulties.
MODE: SCHOOL THEN TUNE. School first: how Battle Brothers tunes (why 5 points of armour is felt; the
armour-penetration and armour-damage split; fatigue as the real limiter; what Legends and other mods changed
and why players kept them; how it is tested), read from the library (reference/library/battle_brothers/).
Then THE NUMBERS TABLE: one data file, every tunable number in it with its reason and its source finding,
nothing hard-coded in a game file; a gate that refuses a number outside the table. TUNING never edits a
system's code; it edits the table and measures the feel through the one driver (does a slightly better
armour change the outcome of the standard fight by a felt amount). It reads the fight through the beat:
quicker than Battle Brothers is the constraint.

## 5. CHAT 22: MODS (mod-friendly, understandable; Sonnet)
"A chat dedicated towards simplifying the code, or just understanding that I want this to be mod friendly
for the community." MODS owns the DATA LINE: every piece of content the community could reasonably change
lives in a data file a modder can read and edit without touching game code (weapons and their shapes,
armour and attachments, backgrounds and names, events and contracts, tiles, sounds, the numbers table,
the words), documented in one place, loaded from a mods/ folder at boot on top of the base content, with a
manifest and a version. MODE: SCHOOL THEN BUILD with PLUMBER: school first on how Battle Brothers is
modded (Legends, the modding kit, what modders needed and lacked), how a web game on a phone can load a mod
(a folder, a URL, a pasted file), and what "simple enough to understand" means for our engine; then the
line, one content kind at a time (weapons first, because TUNING's table needs the same door). PLUMBER
keeps the code small and fast; MODS keeps it READABLE and DATA-DRIVEN; they share the pre-push pass.

## 6. THE ORDER (the manager's; "the running order is mine")
The grid first (rule 34). Then TUNING's school and MODS' school run beside the grid work. TUNING's table
lands when the fight is on the grid; MODS' weapons file is that table's door. Depth is built on a grid
that walks, never before.

## 7. AMENDED 9/28 (Paolo: "tuning right now, I see it as big brain research, and same with mods, and how other games do it with similar big complex frontier coding"; records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_THE_ASSETS_ARE_THE_FIGHTS_GROUND_AND_TUNING_MODS_ARE_RESEARCH_9_28_26.md)
TUNING (21) and MODS (22) are RESEARCH CHATS, like QUESTS (rule 35): MODE: RESEARCH. They study how other
games and studios do it, on big, complex, cutting-edge code bases (how felt numbers are tuned and exposed;
how a large game is built mod-friendly and readable), and write pages the building lanes cite. They build
nothing until he says build. Sections 4 and 5 (the numbers table, the data line, the mods folder) are the
SHAPE they research and recommend; when he flips them to build, PLUMBER with COMBAT wires the table and the
data line to their pages. Research may study any game or studio; the canon's reference list stays his (NEVER
ADD A REFERENCE GAME HE HAS NOT NAMED). Section 6's order: their school runs now, beside the fight-grid work.

## 8. THE HOURS GO TO THE WORLD, NOT THE CHESS BOARD (Paolo 9/29, LOCKED; records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_FASTER_COMBAT_DEEPER_BUILDABLE_WORLD_9_29_26.md)
"In Battle Brothers the chess-playstyle board is the longest part of the gameplay, not the traversing, contracts,
exploration, map. I want it to lean into faster combat and a more deep, rich, interactable, buildable world."
(a) The fight is fast: depth from formation, gear and the dial (s1), speed from gambits carrying the routine; a
routine fight ends inside 90 seconds of beats and a boss fight inside 4 minutes (manager's defaults, TUNING
researches the real Battle Brothers numbers and proposes ours; in VOTE). (b) The hours go to the map, the
settlements, the contracts, the people and BUILDING: a home base you own (37e) is built up from its settlement
screen, lot by lot, from the assets we have; what is built shows on the map, on the fight board cut from that
block, and in the derived future (rule 31). The separate builder screen stays CUT (rule 24); building is a thing
you do in a place. (c) The split is measured: EYES reports where a session's minutes go; the fight is under a
third of them (default, in VOTE).

## 9. CORRECTED BY HIM THE SAME HOUR (records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_TOUGH_BATTLES_ARE_30_40_MINUTES_9_29_26.md): "tough battles can be 30 to 40 minutes... I don't know about 90
seconds, who told you that... shorter than 30 to 40 even for tough battles... either the enemy is higher level,
or better equipment, or you fucked up." s8(a)'s 90-second and 4-minute numbers were the manager's invention and
are DEAD. The ruling: shorter than Battle Brothers' 30 to 40 minutes even for tough fights. Defaults (in VOTE;
TUNING measures real play and refines): a routine fight 2 to 4 minutes; a tough fight 8 to 15, never past 15.
A fight is tough for exactly three reasons, and those are TUNING's difficulty dials: enemy level, enemy gear,
your mistake.

## 10. SWAP A WEAPON MASTERY PAST LEVEL 11, AND THE MOD FEATURES ARE VANILLA (Paolo 9/29, LOCKED; records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_SWAP_A_WEAPON_MASTERY_PAST_LEVEL_11_9_29_26.md)
"In the end game, when you have your team, you should be able to switch out a weapon mastery after you've levelled
up past level 11, instead of needing to use mods in Battle Brothers." (a) Past level 11 a veteran may swap one
weapon mastery for another, at a settlement's training ground, for batteries and a few days (defaults, in VOTE;
TUNING's rows). Below 11 the pick is permanent. (b) THE WIDER RULE: what Battle Brothers players install mods to
get is vanilla here (his 'modded vanilla++'); MODS (22) researches the list (what the big mods fix, why players
wanted them, what it cost the base game's balance) and the building lanes take what fits, one default at a time.

## 11. WHERE YOU BUILD: WHAT YOU HOLD, AND WHAT YOU HOLD GROWS (Paolo's question 9/29; manager's default A, in VOTE; records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_WHERE_CAN_YOU_BUILD_BASE_SETTLEMENT_OR_EVERYTHING_9_29_26.md)
You build on the lots of the parts of Vegas you HOLD (37e). Taking the next part (a raid, a contract, a boss's verb,
a deal) makes it yours to build; losing it takes it back (37c). A base is every block you hold and can be half the
city by act 3. Bosses, contracts and deeds hand you PARTS, unlock KINDS of building (the rungs), and make the
places you helped improve on their own, the Battle Brothers way. Nobody edits a block they do not hold: the
Pocket City 2 'edit everything' route is not this game (that reference is the drop-in transition only, 7/1).

## 12. THE SIX RESOURCES, AND THE GUNS DECIDED TOGETHER (Paolo 9/29, LOCKED; records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_FIVE_RESOURCES_LIKE_BATTLE_BROTHERS_AND_GUNS_DECIDED_TOGETHER_9_29_26.md)
(a) Battle Brothers' five resources are ours, translated: crowns = BATTERIES, provisions = FOOD, medicine = MEDS,
ammo = ROUNDS, repair tools = TAPE; plus WATER, the desert's sixth. Each is consumed the Battle Brothers way
(per man per day, per shot, per plate, per wound); the company ledger carries all six; TUNING numbers them; the
data line holds them. (b) The weapon mapping is DECIDED TOGETHER: COMBAT researches every option (Battle Brothers'
classes and rules, the real arsenal of a collapsed Vegas) and puts them in VOTE two or three options per class;
his pick is canon; his 9/29 pistol-and-machine-gun lines are examples, not rulings.

# LAW BOHEMIA_LAW_BATTLE_BROTHERS_AMOUNT_OUR_VARIETY_9_27_26.md
# source: laws/BOHEMIA_LAW_BATTLE_BROTHERS_AMOUNT_OUR_VARIETY_9_27_26.md
====================================================================================================
# BOHEMIA LAW -- BATTLE BROTHERS' AMOUNT, OUR VARIETY (Paolo 9/27/26)
# His words, verbatim, to the PEOPLE chat:
#   "I think the way you interact with people in battle Brothers is extremely well done
#    maybe that's the amount that we should be interacting with people in our game maybe
#    however all everything that we've done all the research we've done gives us way more
#    chat bubble options or whatever so keep that in mind"
# Rule 33 (THE OVERWORLD IS BATTLE BROTHERS) section 5 is the department this sits in.

## 1. WHAT HE RULED, AND WHAT HE DID NOT
TWO HALVES, AND THEY PULL OPPOSITE WAYS ON PURPOSE:
  THE AMOUNT    how OFTEN a person interacts with you should look like Battle Brothers,
                which is rarely, deliberately, and it matters when it happens.
  THE VARIETY   what they SAY should draw on everything this fleet has researched, so
                the same thing almost never comes back twice. Battle Brothers has
                nothing like our material and he knows it.

HE SAID "MAYBE" TWICE AND THAT IS PRESERVED HERE RATHER THAN ROUNDED OFF. The
DIRECTION is a ruling: fewer, bigger, never-repeating. The exact number is not set, and
"keep that in mind" is a standing consideration, not an order to go mute the town.

## 2. WHAT BATTLE BROTHERS' AMOUNT ACTUALLY IS
Battle Brothers has no street, so it has NO AMBIENT TALK AT ALL. Every interaction is a
discrete event you cannot miss: hiring at a tavern, an event that stops the party,
negotiating a contract. The amount is LOW and each one is a MOMENT. That is the shape he
is pointing at, and it means the number to compare is not "how many noises does our
street make", it is "how many times did somebody address HIM".

## 3. MEASURED ON THE ALPHA THE SAME ROUND HE SAID IT (4 minutes of play)
    different lines written across every organ           625
    ambient lines written into the table                 558 in 152 buckets
    DIFFERENT LINES THE WHOLE STREET COULD EVER SAY       14
    different lines heard in four minutes                 13
    times the most repeated line came back                10
    lines in one person's pool                             5, for all 61 people

*** AND THEN THE NUMBER THAT INVERTS HIS QUESTION ***
    people within earshot, mean                         0.22
    the most there has EVER been at once                   1
    beats with NOBODY close enough to speak         188 of 240
    different people who spoke in the whole play           3
    lines said by the busiest of those three              40 of 54

THE TOWN IS NOT TALKING TOO MUCH. There is almost never anybody there. What reads as
chatter is ONE MAN with eight lines saying all eight of them five times, because he is
the only person standing near you.

## 4. WHAT THIS MEANS FOR THE WORK, AS A STANDING RULE
(a) A POOL GETTING BIGGER IS NOT THE SAME AS HEARING MORE. Any lane that widens a line
    table MEASURES WHAT IS HEARD IN A PLAY, not what exists in the file. This law was
    written the same round a change made the pool five times bigger and the number of
    different things heard went DOWN.
(b) A STATE COLOURS A VOICE. AN EVENT REPLACES IT. A reaction to something somebody
    SAW or HEARD outranks the weather and should. A permanent fact -- you have met, you
    stand at this rung -- must never become the only thing a person can say, because a
    state is true for ever and a two-line bucket then owns that person for the rest of
    the game.
(c) THE STREET TAKES TURNS. Somebody who has just spoken stands down while anybody else
    is in earshot.
(d) THE AMOUNT IS ONE DIAL, NAMED, so one word from him moves it.
(e) VARIETY IS A CROWD PROBLEM BEFORE IT IS A WORDS PROBLEM. With one person in earshot
    at a time, no table is big enough. PEOPLE [honest crowd] and the enough-people
    measurement are upstream of every line anybody writes.

## 5. WHAT IS NOT RULED, AND STAYS HIS
The NUMBER of interactions per five minutes. He said maybe twice; nobody has picked it.
It is written as one dial with the measurement beside it and it waits for his word.

## 6. GATE OWED
The variety legs are in gates/the_company_is_a_cast_gate.js this round: the street's
reachable pool, the state-versus-event rule, and the taking-turns rule. The AMOUNT leg
is owed and cannot be written until he sets the number.

# LAW BOHEMIA_LAW_TWO_SCALES_ONE_GAME_9_27_26.md
# source: laws/BOHEMIA_LAW_TWO_SCALES_ONE_GAME_9_27_26.md
====================================================================================================
# BOHEMIA LAW -- TWO SCALES, ONE GAME: THE TINY CHARACTER ON AN HONEST GRID (Paolo 9/27/26, LOCKED)
# His words: records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_TWO_SCALES_THE_TINY_CHARACTER_9_27_26.md. Rule 34 on VAMILY.md.
# NEWEST DATE WINS: this law SUPERSEDES THE STEP IS A HOUSE (9/15) and the tile half of BATTERIES ARE THE
# MONEY AND A COMBAT TILE IS A HOUSE (9/4), and RE-READS THE GROUND MAY ZOOM, THE PERSON MAY NOT (9/21).

## 1. TWO SCALES OF ONE WORLD
- THE CLOSE GRID: the character is TINY, one cell, and moves ONE CELL PER STEP ("that we had originally").
  Buildings are many cells; a house has walls, a door and an inside; a car is two cells; the street is
  cells. This is Rogue Fable 4's own grid, and the fight happens ON IT, where he stands (rule 24, one
  mode; rule 33d, RF4 first).
- THE MAP: zoom out and the same world is the Battle Brothers map (rule 33): the party is a marker,
  tap to travel, the clock runs, places are destinations. Arriving zooms back in onto the close grid of
  that place.
- ONE GAME: the squeeze is the door between the two scales; the same buttons; the character never
  grows with the zoom ("your character stays tiny even as you zoom out"). No mode.

## 2. THE GRID IS HONEST
"Even when I'm large I don't have to worry about bumping into a wall I can't get past." Every cell is
exactly one of FLOOR (walkable), WALL (blocks movement and sight), DOOR (passable, a threshold), COVER
(the mound: the one terrain effect, accuracy) or PROP (blocks movement, not sight). What is drawn on a
cell IS what the cell is: no picture is pasted over cells that disagree with it. A person can always
reach any floor cell that connects to his; a sealed yard is a wall with a door, or it is not on the grid.
THE MACHINE GATE: for every block, the drawing and the grid agree cell for cell; every floor region
connects to the street; a pressed direction into a wall never reads as a dead pad (the wall shows itself).

## 3. ONE HOUSE IS MANY CELLS
"One house doesn't equal one tile, it's all fucked up." THE STEP IS A HOUSE (Paolo 9/15) is DEAD as a
rule of the walked surface and the fight: a step is one cell, a house is about 4 by 4 cells, a person is
one cell. The 9/15 law's file stays for the record with a SUPERSEDED header. A COMBAT TILE IS A HOUSE
(9/4, the batteries addendum's second half) is DEAD the same way; batteries stay the money.

## 4. THE PERSON IS ONE SMALL SIZE (rule 21 re-read)
THE GROUND MAY ZOOM, THE PERSON MAY NOT stands as a rule about consistency: the person is one size at
every zoom of the close grid, and a marker on the map. The size is ONE CELL (default about 28 px tall
on a 32 px cell), not 112 px. The 112 px bodies, the runway clothes at that size, the clips and the
portraits are ASSETS: the HD source the small sprite is cut from, the face in the bubble, the VOTE
pages. Nothing drawn at 112 is thrown away; it stops being the walked sprite.

## 5. THE DEFAULTS (in VOTE as one item; his to knock down)
A cell about 32 CSS px on a phone (about 11 across, 25 tall). A person one cell. A house about 4x4 cells
with a door and an inside. A car 2x1. A street 3 cells wide with a 1-cell sidewalk each side. Reach in
the fight in cells (pistol, rifle, scope: COMBAT re-derives the 9/22 numbers on the new grid). The mound
is one cell.

## 6. THE REBUILD
THE GRID is a REBUILD on the revamp list (records/BOHEMIA_THE_REVAMP_LIST_9_24_26.md), from the ground up
on assets we have: the valley data (which cells are which is derived from it), the tile banks (cut to
cell size), the 112 art (cut down or redrawn small), the fight rules (re-derived in cells). "I don't know
if we have to restart the whole enchilada": for the walked surface and the fight board, yes; for the
people, the money, territory, the door, the look and the acts, no.
- WORLD + LIFE+CITY [honest grid]: what is on the grid and what is not, cell by cell, for one block first
  (his exact ask: "do a really good job at analyzing what should be on the grid and what should not be").
- COMBAT [fight on the grid]: the RF4 fight on the close grid, reach in cells, the mound, weapon shapes.
- CHARACTER [small body] + ANIMATION [small clips]: the one-cell sprite and its clips, cut from the 112
  assets or redrawn, eight facings, under the bible.
- COOK [cell tiles]: the tile banks at cell size; DIRECTION [two scales look]: the close grid and the
  map under one bible; RUN [two scales]: the squeeze between them and the demo's first sixty seconds.
- PLUMBER [grid budget]: a block of cells, the people on it and the fight, at 60 on the phone profile.

## 7. THE DEMO
"The demo is still not even playable from the very beginning." Rule 18 stands (four things) and gains a
sentence: THE FIRST SIXTY SECONDS ARE A GAME. Loading, then he is a small figure on an honest grid and
every press moves him one cell; the map one squeeze away; the fight where he stands; the first person by
name. RUN cuts it when the grid exists; until then the demo is what it is and nobody pretends otherwise.

## 8. AMENDED 9/28 BY HIS THIRD VOTES (laws/BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_THE_THIRD_VOTES_9_28_26.md, NEWEST DATE WINS)
(a) NO ATARI: "tiny" means small relative to buildings at FULL pixel detail; the 32 px cell and the 28 px sprite
    defaults are DEAD; he sees tile OPTIONS from our assets first (WORLD + COOK [tile options]).
(b) PLACES ARE SETTLEMENT SCREENS: arriving opens a Battle Brothers-style settlement screen (tap a building);
    walking on foot survives only in the fight and in special places (the Strip); the pad is dead elsewhere.
(c) THE GRID IS SQUARE. (d) Sections 5 and 7 are read through this; section 2's honest grid stands for the fight.

## 9. AMENDED 9/28 (Paolo, laws/BOHEMIA_LAW_THE_OVERWORLD_IS_BATTLE_BROTHERS_9_24_26.md s12): THE CLOSE SCALE IS
THE FIGHT AND THE SPECIAL PLACES, NOT THE CITY. "Your character moving tile to tile throughout the city, it's
not gonna be like that anymore, that has to change immediately." One cell per step stands where he is on foot:
the fight and the Strip (and whatever he names). Crossing the city is the map. Section 1's 'the tiny character
crosses the city one cell at a time' is DEAD; sections 2 and 6 (the honest grid, the cell kinds) stand for the
grounds that are walked. The far scale is the Battle Brothers map at Battle Brothers' pixel count or more.

## 10. AMENDED 9/28, SECOND TIME (Paolo: 'for the combat a tile is as big as a house'; records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_A_COMBAT_TILE_IS_A_HOUSE_I_READ_IT_BACKWARDS_9_28_26.md): THIS LAW'S CLOSE
SCALE WAS THE EXPLORATION WALK, AND THE WALK IS DEAD (s9). Its fight leg ("the fight is on the close grid where
he stands", s1, s7) was the coordinator's reading and is DEAD: the fight is on HOUSE TILES (A COMBAT TILE IS A
HOUSE, 9/4, 9/24, 9/28). What survives of this law: the person never grows with the zoom (rule 21), the squeeze
is the door, the far scale is the Battle Brothers map, and the honest-grid idea only where a place is walked on
foot (the Strip; his list). The one-cell sprite and the cell tiles stop.

# LAW BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_QUESTS_IS_RESEARCH_ONLY_9_27_26.md
# source: laws/BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_QUESTS_IS_RESEARCH_ONLY_9_27_26.md
====================================================================================================
# BOHEMIA ADDENDUM -- QUESTS IS RESEARCH ONLY (Paolo 9/27/26, LOCKED)
# His words: records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_QUESTS_IS_RESEARCH_ONLY_9_27_26.md. Rule 35 on VAMILY.md.
# Amends QUESTS ARE UNPARKED (9/6) and the QUESTS lane's MODE; the QUEST STUDY LAW (7/26) stands and gets teeth.

1. QUESTS IMPLEMENTS NOTHING. "I don't want a single thing from the quest chat implemented." Chat 19 is a
   RESEARCH lane (MODE: RESEARCH), like ECONOMY and DYNASTY. It writes no game code, registers no play-surface
   change, ships no quest. Its every push is a record.
2. IT CONTINUOUSLY MINES THE LIBRARY. The library is the 152 studied quests (questbook/, 240 studies), the four
   masters (craft, flaws, ports, conversations), the 3,672 indexed findings, the 22 legendary teardowns
   (laws/BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_BEST_QUESTS_COLLECTION_7_13_26.md) and the 58 designed Bohemia quests as a bank. Every
   round: one page, on one question the building lanes need, answered FROM the library with citations by id
   (Q001.W4 style), the way the QUEST STUDY LAW already demands.
3. THE QUESTIONS, IN ORDER (the coordinator's; the lane refills them): (a) what a Battle Brothers-style EVENT
   on our map should be, pulled from the best quests ever made (a situation, a face, two or three choices,
   a consequence in the ledgers); (b) the TWIST BANK: the twists the 152 use, sorted by what they cost the
   player, for contracts with one twist each; (c) QUESTS ACROSS THE THREE ACTS (rule 31): the delayed payoff
   (the Bloody Baron's Whispering Hillock), planted in one act and landing in another; (d) THE ASK IN A PLACE:
   how the best quests hand you a job through a person, never a board; (e) THE FIRST SIXTY SECONDS: what the
   best openings do and do not do (rule 32a, 34); (f) what the 693 flaws say we must not do on a phone.
4. WHO BUILDS. Events, contracts and asks are BUILT by RUN, WORLD, PEOPLE and WORDS when the map and the grid
   exist, reading QUESTS' pages and citing them; the asks generator, the boss ladder verbs and the word banks
   are assets they use. A building lane that ships an event without a QUESTS citation is refused by the
   coordinator (the QUEST STUDY LAW's gate covers the .bq files; the coordinator covers the board).
5. THE CHAT. A fresh chat whose first word is "quests" takes lane 19; the DYNASTY chat, which has held lane 19
   since 9/6, returns to its own lane. The VAMILY.md section for QUESTS is rewritten to this mode.

6. AT VOLUME, SORTED FOR THE FUTURE (Paolo 9/27, same round; records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_QUESTS_AT_VOLUME_AND_THE_BB_SHAPE_9_27_26.md). "I don't want you to finish one question
   one round, I don't even want you to finish three." The lane works at volume: many pages a round, and the
   product is a LIBRARY OF QUEST DESIGNS ALREADY SUITED TO OUR WORLD, filed by ACT (era), by EVENT, by
   ENDGAME CRISIS, by BOOM OR BUST, each citing the findings it came from, so that months from now the pieces
   are already cut. The six questions are the first shelf, not a pace.
7. THE SHAPE IS BATTLE BROTHERS, SIMPLIFIED, AT YOUR PACE. ONE MAIN QUEST runs. SIDE QUESTS ARE CONTRACTS: a
   person in a place offers, you take it or you do not; once TAKEN you finish it. A little more than Battle
   Brothers: dialogue choices inside. DECLINING IS FREE: the game never makes you feel bad for turning a job
   down, for the pay being low, for the job being beneath you or too strong for you; nobody remembers a no;
   only a contract taken and dropped is a deed. The quests produced before this rule "look like dogshit" as
   things; they stay a bank.
8. THE BLIND SPOTS he asked for: records/BOHEMIA_THE_BLIND_SPOTS_9_27_26.md.

## 9. AMENDED 9/30 BY PAOLO (records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_ONE_MAIN_QUEST_TWO_CONTRACTS_THE_PHONE_ONLY_SHOWS_9_30_26.md): ONE MAIN QUEST AT A TIME; TWO CONTRACTS AT A TIME (Battle Brothers' one is
'wack': a caravan to a city plus a hunt near it on one road); THE PHONE SHOWS WHICH SETTLEMENTS OFFER WHICH
CONTRACTS RIGHT NOW AND CANNOT ACCEPT ONE; a contract is taken from a mouth at the place. Section 3 stands
otherwise (take or leave, declining free, once taken you finish).

# LAW BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_THE_SECOND_VOTES_9_24_26.md
# source: laws/BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_THE_SECOND_VOTES_9_24_26.md
====================================================================================================
# BOHEMIA ADDENDUM -- THE SECOND VOTES (Paolo 9/23 in the tab, pasted 9/24; LOCKED)
# 31 verdicts; his words: records/BOHEMIA_VOTE_VERDICTS_9_23_26.txt; the reading:
# records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_SECOND_VOTES_9_24_26.md. NOTES ARE RULINGS. Rule 32 on VAMILY.md.

## 1. NOTHING IS FORCED, AND NOTHING HAPPENS IN THE FIRST SECOND (32a)
"Why does everything have to happen the first second of the game or even be in the demo?" "Don't
force this on me." "Don't force interactions on the player." Said three ways in one batch.
- The first minutes of the game are HIS. Nobody speaks to him, stops him, or stands in his door
  until he has walked. The world arrives with time, on the beat of its own clock.
- A person who wants something STANDS THERE and can be walked past; an ask is a person in a place,
  never a stop. A rumour is OVERHEARD as he passes, never said to his face. The creditor who
  remembers his father is there when he walks by, one line, once, and never in the first minute.
- The demo is the four things (rule 18) and NOTHING ELSE fires in it.
- Amends A QUEST IS PEOPLE, PLACES AND THINGS: add "and none of them blocks him". Gate: every
  spoken line has a distance and a delay; nothing speaks in the first 60 s of play; nothing speaks
  unless he is within its reach; nothing halts the pad.

## 2. THE GAME STARTS IN THE RUIN AND THE FUTURE GETS BETTER (32b)
"The future gets better. The right side is what the beginning of the game is supposed to look like,
and it gets better. How better is up to you. When civilization reclaims parts of cities for economic
purposes it will get more techy and modern."
- ACT 1 IS THE RUIN. What WORLD drew as "a hundred years on" is the START: cracked lots, a slab
  where the house was, the corner legible with nobody in it, power pulled back to a live core.
- ACT 2 AND ACT 3 ARE THE RUIN PLUS WHAT WAS RECLAIMED. Reclaimed means RETURNED TO ECONOMIC USE,
  and reclaimed ground reads techier and more modern than the start (repaired, rewired, built up,
  screens and lights and new machines on old bones), never the same ruin twice.
- THE FLOOR IS THE START. Nothing decays below act 1. The coordinator's 9/24 default (a dark street
  loses its district at the fold) is DEAD. ECONOMY Q50's finding that the fold only goes up is the
  RIGHT SHAPE; what was missing was a floor that looks like a ruin and a top that looks reclaimed.
  A player who does nothing flips forward and sees the same ruin, plus whatever the world did
  without him (the factions still move). THAT is the report card: not decay, but the absence of
  your fingerprints.
- HOW MUCH BETTER IS THE MANAGER'S DIAL, by his words, and it goes in VOTE like every default.
- THE THREE ACTS AT ONCE law, section 2, is amended to this. DYNASTY [the derive], WORLD [future
  city], LIFE+CITY [three cities], DIRECTION [three eras], ECONOMY Q51 all read this section first.

## 3. THE PHONE IS IN THE CITY VIEW ONLY, AND IT IS A CRACKED IPHONE (32c)
"You only see the phone when you're zoomed out to the whole city view, not when it's the human close
shit. And the phone should look like a cracked iPhone."
- UI [phone on the street] is REVERTED: no phone on the walked street. The morning and the night
  notices (rule 19a) reach him when he zooms out, or through a mouth on the street.
- The drawn phone is a cracked iPhone: a real slab, black glass, a spider crack, the chipping he
  liked (his 9/21 note stands). Not a console, not a card.
- The flip between the acts (his A) lives on that phone: three faces on the cracked glass, in the
  city view. Flipping is a city-view act.
- Amends THE FEED ON THE CITY SCREEN (9/4) only by adding the look; the feed stays city-only as ruled.

## 4. THE THREE NAMES COME PREPARED (32d)
"You can't flip to them until you name them previously, or there's names already prepared for you
like Battle Brothers, and you can reshuffle names or name it yourself."
- One screen before act 1. Each of the three slots comes with a PREPARED name from the county's
  bank (PEOPLE's name mix), a RESHUFFLE that draws another, and a field to type your own. Sex per
  slot the same way (prepared, flip, or choose).
- NO FLIP TO AN UNNAMED DESCENDANT: the faces on the phone stay dark until named.
- Battle Brothers is the campaign-layer reference already; the recruit naming is inside its department.
- DYNASTY [three names] builds it; WORDS [naming screen] writes it; PEOPLE feeds the bank.

## 5. NO SAND (32e)
"These are all dogshit and unimpressive, you need to really make new sounds, not this sand-sounding
shit like I'm on the beach." "It all sounded like sand." "Kinda dogshit."
- Three sounds built from band-limited noise (the tape slipping, the run, the flip) killed in one
  batch: the noise RECIPE is dead, not one sound. STOP PRODUCING: a second rejection of the same
  approach ends it for the session.
- What he kept all have a real source: the door, the cloud, the song, the fold, the phone, the room.
  New sounds are made from real material (recorded, sampled, physically modelled from a named
  object), and every sound in the module that leans on the shared noise band is suspect until
  re-heard; the 21% leak above the corner (SOUNDS f8b3280) is likely the sand itself.
- The room stays at B (lower still). The footstep cadence question stands, on a footstep that is not sand.

## 6. SHOW IT FROM THE GAME'S CAMERA (32f)
"This game isn't in first person, when would I see this?" "The picture we won't use that."
- A VOTE item is drawn from the camera he plays in: the street's 45 and the city's top-down. An
  eye-level render, a sheet, a chart or a map graphic is research, not a candidate, and does not go
  in the tab. COOK EVERY ROUND's "a real thing he can see" means a thing he could meet in the game.
- PLUMBER [cook gate] gets the leg: an image item's source is a frame off a play surface or a tile
  at game scale; a lane that needs to show a study puts it in a record.

## 7. THE SMALL RULINGS
- Footprints wander ("not exactly a straight line") and point where the walker faced (N S E W).
- The Sphere: the bottom-left square clips on top; a small hole in the roof, made to look good.
- Sand is the colour of the rest of the dirt, never white-grey.
- The runway thirteen: vibrance down a little (DIRECTION's six-piece bounce is the same note).
- The new thirteen: nothing clips where it should not.
- Every face dial is a slider ("fantastic progress").
- "What is 'the watch'?": a name he has never met in a mouth is jargon; a story names a person or a
  place he can find, or says "somebody".
- The hand at the face, killed twice: graveyard, ANIMATION stops on it this session.
- The shirt that is not cloth, the dark institutions: graveyard.

## 8. WHAT CHANGES ON THE BOARD
RUN [banner eats fingers] stays first (walking). PEOPLE [creditor stands] re-aimed under 32a (not the
first second, walk past). UI [phone city only] first (revert the pocket phone; cracked iPhone).
SOUNDS [not sand] first. WORLD [future city] and DYNASTY [the derive] re-aimed under 32b. DYNASTY
[three names] under 32d. ANIMATION hand-at-face to the graveyard. COOK: the four small fixes. PLUMBER
[cook gate] gains the camera leg. CHARACTER: vibrance, clipping. WORDS/PEOPLE: no jargon in a mouth.

## 11. AMENDED 9/28 (rule 32b, laws/BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_THE_THIRD_VOTES_9_28_26.md s3): THE FUTURE GOES BOTH WAYS. Built rises; raided falls; the derive is
signed; "the future is a reflection of your past actions." The start is still the ruin.

# LAW BOHEMIA_LAW_THE_OVERWORLD_IS_BATTLE_BROTHERS_9_24_26.md
# source: laws/BOHEMIA_LAW_THE_OVERWORLD_IS_BATTLE_BROTHERS_9_24_26.md
====================================================================================================
# BOHEMIA LAW -- THE OVERWORLD IS BATTLE BROTHERS (Paolo 9/24/26, "an executive decision", LOCKED)
# His words: records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_THE_OVERWORLD_IS_BATTLE_BROTHERS_9_24_26.md. Rule 33 on VAMILY.md.
# The game in one line, his: ECONOMIC APOCALYPSE BATTLE BROTHERS ON A PHONE, WITH A BETTER STORY.

## 1. THE OVERWORLD IS THE BATTLE BROTHERS MAP
Crossing the valley is done the Battle Brothers way: a MAP with your party on it as a marker, tap
where you want to go, the party travels there while time passes, roads are faster than dirt and
ruins, other parties roam and can be seen coming, places (blocks, towns, camps, plants, pumps) are
destinations you enter. "It's just so much easier to travel the world that way, quicker."
- THE MAP IS THE CITY VIEW WE HAVE (default, in VOTE). One squeeze out from the street is already the
  zoomed-out valley with the cracked phone on it (RUN [way back], UI [phone city only]); that view
  gains the Battle Brothers travel mechanics. No new screen, no new mode (rule 24): the same buttons,
  the same UI, the squeeze is the door.
- THE STREET IS WHERE YOU ARRIVE (default, in VOTE). The walked street at one step per house does
  not die; it stops being how you cross the valley and becomes the PLACE you enter from the map,
  where the people are and where the fight happens on house tiles. Battle Brothers enters a town as
  a set of menus; we enter it as a street. He corrects in VOTE.
- THE FLIP LIVES HERE TOO: the cracked phone on the map carries the three descendants (rule 31, 32c).

## 2. EVENTS ON THE ROAD
"We can still have so many cool things like pop-up events and stuff." Battle Brothers events are the
model: travel is interrupted by a situation, a face and a few lines, two or three real choices, a
consequence that lands in the ledgers. THIS AMENDS RULE 32a FOR THE MAP ONLY: an event may stop the
party on the road. It still never fires in the first minute of play, it still comes from a mouth
with a portrait (rule 19), it is never a card floating over the street, and the choice is real (a
Battle Brothers event with one option is not an event). On the street, 32a stands whole: nothing
forced, walk past.

## 3. THE FIGHT: ROGUE FABLE 4 FIRST, BATTLE BROTHERS SECOND, ON HOUSE TILES
"Each tile is as big as a mini block, like a building." "Very inspired by Rogue Fable 4, because if
Rogue Fable 4 touched the combat of Battle Brothers more, it'd be more fun."
- The tile is a building (rule 16, BATTERIES ARE THE MONEY AND A COMBAT TILE IS A HOUSE). Unchanged.
- ROGUE FABLE 4 LEADS THE FEEL: on the beat, quick, the grid, verbs; BATTLE BROTHERS IS THE FLAVOUR
  (the 9/22 addendum's reach on the tiles, a turn is a beat, routine hits cost one, the dial for the
  important shot all stand; they are read as RF4 speed with BB weight).
- TERRAIN: ONE EFFECT IN THE WHOLE FIGHT. "No terrain stand-on effect, really, other than a small
  mound on the floor you can get an accuracy bonus from." High ground = accuracy bonus. Nothing else
  on a tile changes a number: no cover values, no slow ground, no elevation ladders. COMBAT removes
  any other tile effect that exists and the gate refuses a new one.

## 4. THE REVAMP, AND THE DEMO
"We are in a part of the revamp process." The playable cut (rule 18) keeps four things and one of them
changes shape: LOADING, TRAVEL + ARRIVAL (the map to a place, the place as a street), THE FIGHT, THE
FIRST PERSON. RUN cuts it. "I don't need the whole world" still binds: the demo is one map with a few
places, not the valley.

## 5. CONTINUOUS BATTLE BROTHERS RESEARCH: EVERY CHAT HAS A LINE
"I need you to just continuously do big brain research on how Battle Brothers does things really
good." The 8/28 BATTLE BROTHERS STUDY becomes STANDING, the way the analog horror line did (rule 20h):
EVERY CHAT carries a [bb ...] line and answers it as SCHOOL first (one page: how Battle Brothers does
that department well, measured off the real game and its design talks, what players remember, what
they complain about), then the shape for us in plain words, then rows. The coordinator's round zero is
records/BOHEMIA_BATTLE_BROTHERS_SCHOOL_THE_MAP_ROUND_ZERO_9_24_26.md.
  RUN [bb map] the map and travel  |  WORLD [bb places] towns, camps, what a place offers  |
  QUESTS [bb events] events and contracts  |  PEOPLE [bb company] recruits, backgrounds, traits, the
  brothers  |  COMBAT [bb fight] what BB's fight has that RF4 lacks, and the mound  |  UI [bb interface]
  one HUD across map, street and fight  |  ECONOMY [bb money] the company ledger, wages, prices per
  town  |  FACTIONS [bb houses] noble houses and reputation  |  WORDS [bb event writing]  |  SOUNDS
  [bb ambience] the map's sound  |  DIRECTION [bb look] the map's painted look under our bible  |
  COOK [bb map art] the map's tiles and markers  |  PORTRAIT [bb faces] event and roster faces  |
  CHARACTER [bb gear] what worn gear says  |  DYNASTY [bb legacy] the company across time  |
  EYES [bb reads] how the map reads on a phone  |  PLUMBER [bb budget] what a map costs on a phone  |
  ANIMATION [bb marker] the party marker's motion.
Battle Brothers is already a named reference (the campaign layer); this widens its department to THE
OVERWORLD, TRAVEL, EVENTS, PLACES and THE COMPANY, and nothing else: its fight is flavour only (s3),
its interface is a study only where UI's line says so. NEVER ADD A REFERENCE GAME HE HAS NOT NAMED
stands: Battle Brothers is his, Rogue Fable 4 is his, nothing new enters.

## 5b. WHERE BATTLE BROTHERS IS A STILL, WE MOVE (Paolo 9/24, same round; records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_BB_IS_PICTURES_WE_PUT_LIFE_IN_IT_9_24_26.md)
"Battle Brothers is just a bunch of pictures and the pictures can change, but we can do more and put
more life into it with this analog horror, pixel, Newgrounds bullshit we're doing." (NEWGROUNDS is his
reference for the look's era, inside the analog horror bible, DIRECTION only; records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_NEWGROUNDS_AND_THE_MACHINE_GUN_9_24_26.md) We take the SHAPE of the
map, the events and the places from Battle Brothers and none of its stillness: the map breathes
(lights, weather, parties moving, tracks appearing), a place is a living street, an event is a
person who moves and speaks under the bible with sound, never an illustrated card. Every [bb ...]
school line ends its "shape for us" with what MOVES that Battle Brothers' picture does not.

## 6. WHAT THIS AMENDS
- THE STEP IS A HOUSE (9/15): stands on the street and in the fight; it no longer describes how the
  valley is crossed. The overworld's unit is the map's own.
- THE FIGHT IS BATTLE BROTHERS, QUICKER (9/22): read as RF4 first, BB flavour; terrain is the mound only.
- THE SECOND VOTES 32a: events may stop the party on the map (s2); the street is untouched.
- THE PILLAR LINE: the game in one line is his 9/24 sentence.
- THE PLAYABLE CUT (9/20) item 2: walking becomes travel + arrival.
- The demo (18i) still ships small: one map, a few places.

## 7. GATES OWED
A one-mode gate (the map, the street and the fight share the HUD, rule 24); a terrain gate (no tile
effect but the mound); the event gate (no event before 60 s, a face and 2-3 choices, never on the
street); the travel gate (roads faster than dirt, time passes, arrival puts him on a street).

## 8. THE REVAMP LIST AND THE EXCAVATION RULE (Paolo 9/24, same round; records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_CUT_AND_REBUILD_9_24_26.md)
"We can't be building on top of shit like this... it needs to be excavated from the files... built from
the ground up using assets we already have." The manager sorted every system into KEEP, CUT and REBUILD:
records/BOHEMIA_THE_REVAMP_LIST_9_24_26.md. A CUT system stops the round it is cut and is moved to archive/ the same round (GRAVEYARD IS
FINAL); nothing live loads from archive/ (PLUMBER gates it); its assets stay where the live systems read
them; a row that builds on a cut system is refused. A REBUILT system starts from the ground up on the
assets we have. The list is in VOTE as one line; he knocks any row down.

## 9. WEAPONS HAVE SHAPES (Paolo 9/24, same round; records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_NEWGROUNDS_AND_THE_MACHINE_GUN_9_24_26.md)
"In Battle Brothers you have some weapons that can hit multiple tiles at the same time, six or three; a
machine gun is comparable to a greatsword or a battle axe." Beside the reach rule (9/22: pistol 1, rifle
2, scope 3) a weapon has a SHAPE on the tiles: the machine gun sweeps a line in one beat. Battle
Brothers flavour under RF4 speed (s3). COMBAT [weapon shapes], school first. Everything still costs one.

## 10. THE LIBRARY (Paolo 9/27: "go through the Battle Brothers wiki and download everything or remember everything, all the stats"; records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_DOWNLOAD_THE_BATTLE_BROTHERS_WIKI_9_27_26.md)
A BATTLE BROTHERS REFERENCE LIBRARY lives at reference/library/battle_brothers/README.md (ten volumes: the map, combat rules, weapons and
their tile shapes, armour, perks, backgrounds, economy, contracts and events, enemies, the interface and
feel). Every [bb ...] school line READS IT FIRST and cites the volume; a lane that finds a number wrong
fixes it there with a source. The first volumes are written from memory, every number tagged (recall),
because the fleet's machines cannot fetch the wiki (network policy); PLUMBER [bb library] is the tool
that pulls every wiki page and dev blog to text the day the hosts are allowed, and the volumes then cite
the fetched pages. The wiki's text is CC BY-SA: the library quotes facts and cites pages; it does not
republish the wiki as ours.

## 11. AMENDED 9/28 BY HIS THIRD VOTES (laws/BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_THE_THIRD_VOTES_9_28_26.md)
Section 1's "the street is where you arrive" default is DEAD: a place opens a SETTLEMENT SCREEN; the map is
REVAMPED with more pixels (the squeeze stays the door); factions are HOME BASES and ROAMING PARTIES, not
territory; movement GLIDES; the grid is SQUARE.

## 12. FULLY COMMITTED: A REVAMP, THE MAP AT BATTLE BROTHERS' PIXELS, NO TILE-TO-TILE THROUGH THE CITY (Paolo 9/28, LOCKED; records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_THE_MAP_AT_BB_PIXELS_AND_NO_TILE_TO_TILE_9_28_26.md)
"Fully committed... not even gonna be close to what we were building, it's gonna be a revamp... pretty much
like Battle Brothers." (a) THE MAP'S PIXEL COUNT IS A FLOOR: measure how many pixels the Battle Brothers map
draws and match that number exactly as the bare minimum; "that has to happen like now." DIRECTION [bb density]
measures it and every map cook is checked against it (gate OWED: PLUMBER, the cook gate's density leg for map
items). Until the measurement lands, the floor is one painted pixel per screen pixel at the phone's own ratio.
(b) THE CHARACTER MOVING TILE TO TILE THROUGH THE CITY IS DEAD, "immediately." The city is crossed on the map
only. The close grid (rule 34) is the FIGHT'S ground and the special places' ground (the Strip; his list), never
the city's floor. Section 1's "the street is where you arrive" was already dead (s11); s4's TRAVEL + ARRIVAL now
reads TRAVEL on the map, ARRIVAL on a settlement screen, THE FIGHT on the close grid. (c) RUN cuts the demo to
that shape; nothing in the demo walks the city.

## 13. *** (b) OF THIS SECTION WAS WRONG AND IS REVERSED BY s14 (Paolo 9/28: 'in combat a tile is as big as a house... I've told you this millions of times'). *** THE ASSETS ARE THE FIGHT'S GROUND, AND NEVER ONE TILE PER SIDEWALK (Paolo 9/28, same round; records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_THE_ASSETS_ARE_THE_FIGHTS_GROUND_AND_TUNING_MODS_ARE_RESEARCH_9_28_26.md)
"All the assets we were creating for when you were just a person walking around zoomed in, tile by tile,
even the sidewalk: all of these assets are going to be used for the combat. Don't get confused. You're never
gonna be in a street fight where one tile is one sidewalk." (a) Every walked-city asset (the tile banks, the
cells, the kerb, the yard, the wall, the door, the car from above, the house as many cells) is THE FIGHT'S
GROUND; nothing of it is archived; s12's cut removes the WALK, not the tiles. (b) Section 3's "on house tiles"
and rule 16's fight half (A COMBAT TILE IS A HOUSE) are DEAD FOR GOOD: the fight's cell is the small honest
cell of rule 34; a sidewalk and a house are many cells; the tiny character stands on one. GRAVEYARD IS FINAL:
a house-sized fight tile does not come back under a new name (gate OWED to COMBAT: the fight board's cell is
the grid's cell, never a building).

## 14. A COMBAT TILE IS A HOUSE. THE COORDINATOR READ s13(b) BACKWARDS. (Paolo 9/28, LOCKED; records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_A_COMBAT_TILE_IS_A_HOUSE_I_READ_IT_BACKWARDS_9_28_26.md)
"In combat the boards and the tiles are as big as parts of the city: a house is one tile. I've told you this
millions of times. We're getting rid of walking the city tile by tile, each tile being a sidewalk, for the
exploration. But for the combat a tile is as big as a house." (a) A COMBAT TILE IS A HOUSE (9/4) stands in
full, as s3 said on 9/24; s13(b) is DEAD; the fight is on HOUSE TILES, never on sidewalk-sized cells. (b) The
sidewalk-sized cell (rule 34's close grid) was the EXPLORATION walk, which s12 killed; the cell-grid FIGHT
(rule 34's fight leg, COMBAT V227 to V229) was the coordinator's reading and is dead with it. (c) The walk's
assets (sidewalk, kerb, yard, wall, door, car) DRESS the house-sized tiles, s13(a). (d) The fight sprite is the
112 px art on house tiles (rule 21, the fought surface). (e) The mound is a house tile with height (a roof,
37g). (f) The tile OPTIONS (37a) are house tiles and street tiles at full detail, from the walk's banks.

## 15. HOUSE-SIZED, NOT HOUSE-FILLED (Paolo 9/28, LOCKED; records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_A_TILE_IS_HOUSE_SIZED_NOT_EVERY_TILE_IS_A_HOUSE_9_28_26.md)
"My one tile is the size of a house doesn't mean every tile is a house. It still has to look like a city. We have
neighbours, we have so many assets, we have streets." A COMBAT TILE IS A HOUSE names the SIZE of a tile. The
CONTENT of a tile is whatever that piece of the city is: house, yard, street, sidewalk and kerb, lot, slab, car,
shed, pump, wall, roof. The board is cut from the city as it stands (the block's own layout) and dressed from the
banks we have (s13a). Gate OWED (COMBAT with WORLD): a fight board carries at least a street and a non-house tile
kind beside its houses, and its layout matches the block it was cut from.

# LAW BOHEMIA_LAW_THE_THREE_ACTS_AT_ONCE_9_23_26.md
# source: laws/BOHEMIA_LAW_THE_THREE_ACTS_AT_ONCE_9_23_26.md
====================================================================================================
# BOHEMIA LAW -- THE THREE ACTS AT ONCE (Paolo 9/23/26, LOCKED as direction; the defaults below are the coordinator's under EVERYTHING IS A THUMB and each one sits in VOTE)
# His words: records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_THE_THREE_ACTS_AT_ONCE_9_23_26.md. "This is a pretty big
# fucking deal... I think this is what the game needed."

## 1. THE THREE ACTS ARE OPEN AT THE SAME TIME
The three generations (Gen 1 Animal, Gen 2 Human, Gen 3 Angel; ERAS, Paolo 9/7) are no longer
played one after another. All three are open from the start of the game and the player FLIPS
between them at will, the way Ocarina of Time flips child Link and adult Link. The ~100 hours
are spent across the three, in whatever order he flips.
THE PILLAR LINE IS AMENDED: "three generations that INHERIT... the player lives all three"
stands; "lives all three AT ONCE, flipping" is added.

## 2. THE FUTURE IS THE PAST'S REPORT CARD, DRAWN AS A CITY
Flip forward and the later act shows what the earlier acts have earned so far. Early in the
game the future city is built like shit, because nothing has been done yet. "If you want to
see more awesome futuristic technology life, you gotta do more in the past." So:
(a) THE FUTURE IS DERIVED, NEVER AUTHORED. Act 2's city and act 3's city are computed from the
    earlier acts' ledgers (deeds, territory, batteries, standing, what was built, who lived)
    every time he flips forward. Nobody hand-places act 3.
(b) IT IS ALWAYS THERE TO LOOK AT. He may flip to act 3 in the first minute and see the ruin
    his nothing has made. The ruin is the tutorial.
(c) WHAT HE DOES IN THE FUTURE IS ITS OWN LEDGER, LAID ON TOP. A flip back to act 1 and a
    change there re-derives act 2 and 3's base; act 2 and 3's own deeds are re-applied on top
    of the new base. Nothing he did in the future is thrown away; it lands on different ground.
    (The Day of the Tentacle rule: the past rewrites the future's world, never the future
    character's hands.)
(d) THE MACHINE GATE: a checker that changes one act-1 ledger row, flips forward, and proves
    the act-3 city changed, and that act 3's own deeds survived the re-derive.

## 3. THE FLIP IS ONE TAP ON THE PHONE (default, in VOTE)
He left it open: "I don't know if you have to do something in game or there's a simple option."
DEFAULT: the flip is ON THE PHONE. The phone is the phone button (Paolo 9/22); it now carries
the three descendants' faces; tap a face, that is who you are. One tap, always available, no
place to walk to, no mode change: the same screen, the same buttons, the same UI (rule 24), the
ground and the date change, the person's size does not (rule 21). Under the analog horror law
it is a phone that shows you a face that has not been born yet.
THE OTHER OPTION, so he can knock the default down: a PLACE in the world (Ocarina's pedestal),
one per district, walk to it to flip. Two options, in VOTE, asked once.

## 4. QUESTS REACH ACROSS THE AGES
A quest may start in one act and finish in another: planted in act 1, standing in act 3;
promised by the grandparent, paid by the heir. The ladder of sixty bosses (records/BOHEMIA_THE_BOSS_LADDER_v7_8_7_26.md) is read again through this: a boss's VERB can be earned in one age
and used in another. QUESTS owns the shape; A QUEST IS PEOPLE, PLACES AND THINGS stands (the
thing that carries across ages is a thing, a place, or a person, never a card).

## 5. THE THREE NAMES (default, in VOTE)
"The names of your three descendants, male or female, at the start of the game probably... or
maybe slides into that early on into each act." DEFAULT: ALL THREE ARE NAMED AND SEXED AT THE
START, one screen before act 1, because the flip is open from minute one and he must know
whose face he is tapping. THE OTHER OPTION: each one is named the first time he flips to them.
Two options, in VOTE. The names are the PLAYER'S to type (not Paolo's to reserve); WORDS ships
the screen's words draft:true; PORTRAIT and CHARACTER derive the three faces and bodies from
his own by the heredity the family law already runs (A FAMILY LOOKS LIKE A FAMILY).

## 6. THE REFERENCE GAME
OCARINA OF TIME is named by him and belongs to ONE department: THE THREE ACTS AT ONCE (the
DYNASTY chat). The flip, the two-age world, the quest across ages. Nothing else of it (not its
combat, not its interface, not its sound, not its dungeons). CLAUDE.md's reference list carries
the line. The games in the school record are research and stay unnamed in the design.

## 7. WHO BUILDS IT
DYNASTY is THE THREE ACTS AT ONCE chat from this round: MODE SCHOOL THEN BUILD (two rounds of
school first, his words: "do big brain research"). It owns the flip, the derive, and the
naming; it hands rows to WORLD and LIFE+CITY (the derived cities), UI (the faces on the phone),
QUESTS (across the ages), WORDS (the naming screen), PORTRAIT and CHARACTER (three faces, three
bodies), SOUNDS (the flip's sound), DIRECTION (three eras under the bible), ECONOMY (how one
act's economy seeds the next), PLUMBER (three world states in a phone's memory: the budget).
RUN builds none of it until the playable cut holds (rule 18); this is ALPHA work. Tab: not in a
tab yet; when it lands, the phone in every tab is the door.

## 8. WHAT IT KILLS AND WHAT IT KEEPS
KILLED: "the fold" as a one-way event at the end of an act (DYNASTY [fold carries] 9/16 stays as
the LIST of what crosses; the crossing is now continuous, every flip). KEPT: the heir, the
inheritance, the Angel, the Animal; who marries whom and who the Angel is stay his.

## 9. AMENDED 9/24 BY HIS SECOND VOTES (laws/BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_THE_SECOND_VOTES_9_24_26.md, NEWEST DATE WINS)
(a) SECTION 2 IS RE-READ: ACT 1 IS THE RUIN, AND THE FUTURE GETS BETTER. "The right side is what the
    beginning of the game is supposed to look like, and it gets better... when civilization reclaims parts
    of cities for economic purposes it will get more techy and modern." The ruin is the FLOOR (act 1's
    ground), never a fall from it; act 2 and 3 are the ruin plus what was reclaimed, and reclaimed reads
    techier and more modern than the start. Nothing decays below the start; a do-nothing player flips
    forward and sees the same ruin plus what the world did without him. How much better is the manager's
    dial, in VOTE. The 9/24 default "a dark street loses its district" is dead.
(b) SECTION 3 STANDS, WITH HIS A: the flip is on the phone. AND THE PHONE IS IN THE CITY VIEW ONLY (32c),
    a cracked iPhone; flipping is a city-view act.
(c) SECTION 5 IS DECIDED BY HIS VOTE: the three names come PREPARED, Battle Brothers style (a generated
    name per slot, reshuffle, or type your own); no flip to an unnamed descendant.

## 10. WHAT THE FLIP IS, IN THE STORY (Paolo 9/28, thinking out loud, ONE QUESTION OPEN; records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_LORE_THE_FLIPS_TECHNOLOGY_AND_NARRATION_9_28_26.md)
He asked what the flip is story-wise and technology-wise, floated an upload, a genetic link, and a
"technological box" twist, and ruled only this: "it has to make sense story wise and technology wise," and
"we need to have more fun with this." The manager's holes and the three shapes are in the record; his letter
decides. REALISM FIRST leads with A: the cool technology that broke the world (7/24 LOCKED #2, restated by him
9/28) is the machine still running in the ruin, and the flip is that machine deriving a family's future from
its records, which is section 2 word for word. Until his letter, DYNASTY [the frame] is SCHOOL ONLY and nothing
in the alpha names the fiction.

## 11. NO FLIP AT THE START; ONE PERSON, THEN THE NEXT IS GENERATED FROM HIM; THE COMPANY INHERITS; THE TWIST IS THE ENDING'S (Paolo 9/28, LOCKED; records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_ENDINGS_THE_COMPANY_ACROSS_ACTS_NO_FLIP_AT_START_BUILD_IT_9_28_26.md)
(a) "You start the game, you can't flip between the three people." The phone shows ONE person until the second
generation unlocks (37j; the unlock moment is the manager's default until he rules: the first home base). Three
faces from frame one (DYNASTY [the flip] as shipped 9/24) is DEAD; the strip grows a face at each unlock.
(b) You customize ONE person at the start. At the first hop into the second generation you are given the option
to customize that person, who STARTS OFF GENERATED FROM HOW YOU MADE THE FIRST (heredity: face, body, name bank);
the third the same from the second. Section 4's naming-all-three-before-act-1 (32d as built) is DEAD as built;
"names come prepared" survives at each first hop (a prepared name, a reshuffle, a field).
(c) THE COMPANY INHERITS (manager's default, in VOTE): each act starts with the heirs of the last act's company,
prepared from the ledger like the city is; gear stays in the family (37g); ~12 men an act, 36 lives a game.
(d) ENDINGS: the Amalgamation is the real villain; good, bad or neutral toward it; different endings. If there is
a twist it is the ENDING'S, never the frame of the whole game. DYNASTY [the ending] researches his signal idea
(travel as data at radio speed; the third character on the Moon with the company) against canon (the Moon and
Mars bases, GDD v2) and against s10's default A; nothing is canon until he rules.
(e) Assassin's Creed is NAMED by him for the story frame and the ending twist only, "possibly"; study allowed,
nothing built from it until an ending is ruled. Ocarina of Time stands as this law's reference.

## 12. WHEN A MAN DIES IN ONE ACT (Paolo's hole 9/28; the answer is s2(c) applied to people; records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_WHEN_A_MAN_DIES_IN_ONE_ACT_9_28_26.md)
Time in the derive flows one way. A death in act 1 removes that line from acts 2 and 3 on the next flip forward
(no heir unless he already had a kid). A death in act 2 or 3 touches nothing in the past; it is that act's own
ledger, and you recruit there. A change in the past re-derives the future's ROSTER but never un-does the future's
deeds. A man recruited later in the past appears as an heir on the next flip forward. The main character never
dies (37g). Heir thresholds are TUNING's rows (default: survived the act, or 60 days with the company, or a
family in the background; heirs 15 to 35 years old; half the parent's traits; the family's gear).

# LAW BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_THE_FIRST_VOTES_9_22_26.md
# source: laws/BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_THE_FIRST_VOTES_9_22_26.md
====================================================================================================
# BOHEMIA ADDENDUM -- THE FIRST VOTES (Paolo 9/21/26 in the tab, pasted 9/22; LOCKED)
# 83 verdicts, his words on 52 of them: records/BOHEMIA_VOTE_VERDICTS_9_21_26.txt. The reading:
# records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_FIRST_VOTES_9_22_26.md. NOTES ARE RULINGS: each comment below is law.

## 1. ONE GAME MODE, NO TELEPORT (rule 24)
"The worst thing you've ever done for me... teleporting shit not part of the universe, the buttons
changing, no consistency... one game mode, not teleporting to different game modes." And on the
fight HUD options: "none are consistent with the rest of the UI... a UI that's not consistent for
every second of the game." THE FIGHT IS NOT A MODE. The cloud passes on the street he is standing
on and the fight happens there: same screen, same buttons, same UI every second of the game. No
cut, no new frame, no second set of controls. The fight's HUD IS the game's HUD; what the fight
adds (reach lit on the tiles, the enemy's beat) is drawn on the same objects. Rule 17 and rule 23
are read through this. COMBAT [one mode] before anything else on that row; UI [one hud].

## 2. THE VOTE TAB SHOWS THE THING (rule 25)
"How dare you show me pictures of animations and not the actual animation, never do that again."
"It's like an interactive inside of an interactive, you better have gotten my votes." "I already
voted one time inside this interactive, come correct and know the results." "There's 7 options
here, wtf." "Please have all the notes inside of this interactive."
- An animation item PLAYS on the row. A sound item PLAYS on the row. A still of a motion is banned.
- An item is asked ONCE. A vote cast inside an item's own page lands in the one COPY ALL export;
  the row does not ask again. Until UI wires that, an item's page carries NO vote of its own.
- Two or three options, never more. A/B/C, the question format he already ruled (8/4).
- His per-item notes ride inside the page and come out with the export.

## 3. SLIDE, NOW (rule 26)
"I want slide immediately." The walk feel is SLIDE. The manager's 9/21 tape default is DEAD and
the drop-a-frame vote is moot. Walking is item 2 of the cut, so this ships now.

## 4. THE PLAYER DOES NOT SPEAK SPANGLISH (rule 27)
"Chill with the Spanglish. Some characters might speak Spanglish to you, doesn't mean you will."
THEY SPEAK SPANGLISH (8/25) is amended: some characters do; the player's own lines never do. The
language gate gets a leg: zero Spanish in the player's own lines.

## 5. THE ALPHA'S UI IS FROZEN, AND THE PICKS STAND (rule 28)
"Let's never worry about the UI of the alpha amendments ever again, it's all good in the hood
until I tell you; let's worry about the demo." UI cooks no more alpha UI options into VOTE. The
picks: the game opens C; a person talks A (and may differ per act); the vote tab sits D; the top
bar D, and the phone keeps the chipping and the broken glass he liked; the game loads B ("not
analog horror enough, keep going"); a choice looks A; the writing reads D; the screen reads C; a
label is spaced E; the size of a choice is a SETTING ("looks better tinier in the sun"); four
buttons "ok, small"; the queue "okay the way it is"; one door: research how Battle Brothers does
it before another option. Each pick is built into the demo's UI by UI, no second vote.

## 6. TEXT ITEMS ARE BORING; MAKE THE PIXELS, MAKE THE SOUND (rule 29)
"Boring asf" on the first ask spoken, the phone notice, the wrong detail, the first notice, who
sends the notice; "idk what I was reading"; "the UI of this is buggy, reshow me better"; and his
last line: "no more cards with quests, just make an actual quest, make the pixels, make the
sound." A line of text is not a thing. WORLD, WORDS and QUESTS register no more text-only items.
Words ride inside a thing he can see or hear: the person who says them, the paper drawn on the
table, the sign. The thing is the item.

## 7. MORE ANALOG HORROR, AND THE RUNWAY NAMES (rule 30)
Said fourteen times: faces, tiles, signs, the shed, the loading screen. Every re-cook of a killed
item goes through DIRECTION's bible before it comes back as a new id. For clothes he named the
runway: "analog horror direction meets Rick Owens meets Balenciaga meets Bottega Veneta." Those
are fashion houses, not games; the reference rule is untouched. CHARACTER and COOK dress the
valley to them, under the bible.

## 8. NOBODY STANDS ON ANYBODY
"Why are so many people on top of each other, on each other's ass... looks like complete dogshit,"
said twice. The crowd clumps. PEOPLE [no clumping], un-held: bodies keep the world's own spacing,
nobody overlaps, and the crowd count follows the world's clock (the 9/22 default he has not
overruled).

## 9. THE SMALL RULINGS
- The room hum on the tap: "very, very, very low." SOUNDS sets it and he says when.
- Names: "a little more percentage of white people names, keep it natural, this game isn't a
  Hispanic-ass game." PEOPLE tunes the bank to the county's real mix and says the numbers.
- People charge batteries: "mfs charge batteries, buildings can help." A person with a rig
  charges a cell; a building helps; charging is not a building's monopoly. WORLD/ECONOMY.
- Tracks are pixel art: "make pixel art of footsteps that lead you to the conclusion, not a
  storytime." COOK draws footprints; WORDS writes none.
- Haggling: "do it the same way Battle Brothers does it: push too much hurts reputation. Nothing
  less than Battle Brothers." QUESTS [haggle like bb].
- The car sheet: "what is the grey brick blocks behind the cars." A sheet's backdrop is the
  world or nothing.
- Faces: "we need way more face and portrait customizations before you hand me shit; I like the
  eyes not being all white, less of a frog." The face maker (HE CAN BUILD HIS OWN FACE) comes
  before more candidates; the eye direction stands.
- Ages and heights: yes to both; "the old person looks like shit" is a redraw, not a no.
- The clothes: "keep cooking clothing, hairstyles, faces and portraits before you show me."
  Volume of cooking, fewer showings, under rule 22 the cooking goes to VOTE in batches.

## 10. WHAT AN UP MEANS NOW
Approved goes into the game the round the hold allows (rule 15c): the idle, the turn, the three
COOK tiles, the notes section, the names, the shed (after DIRECTION), the water sign (after
DIRECTION), the sounds (the door, the cloud, the song, the fold, the phone, the room at very low).

# LAW BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_THE_FIGHT_IS_BATTLE_BROTHERS_QUICKER_9_22_26.md
# source: laws/BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_THE_FIGHT_IS_BATTLE_BROTHERS_QUICKER_9_22_26.md
====================================================================================================
# BOHEMIA ADDENDUM -- THE FIGHT IS BATTLE BROTHERS, QUICKER, AND THE DIAL IS FOR THE IMPORTANT SHOT (Paolo 9/22/26, LOCKED)
# His words, verbatim: records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_COMBAT_LIKE_BATTLE_BROTHERS_QUICKER_9_22_26.md.
# "I don't need the whole world. I do need the combat to feel like Battle Brothers: a pistol
# feeling like a one-tile weapon, an assault rifle like a two-tile weapon. Battle Brothers but
# quicker and funner, infused with Rogue Fable. I don't know if we have to restart combat from
# the ground up. The Dead Eye Dial can be a great idea for important parts of the combat."

## 1. WHAT IT AMENDS
- Rule 17 (THE FIGHT LOOKS LIKE THE GAME, 9/18) froze COMBAT to the look. This adds THE FEEL.
  Item 3 of THE PLAYABLE CUT (9/20) is now "the fight looks AND FEELS like the game".
- The reference rule stands: BATTLE BROTHERS is the campaign layer, ROGUE FABLE 4 is the fight
  on the beat. He is naming what the fight has to FEEL like, and the feel he names is BB's
  positioning (reach, adjacency, the group) at RF4's speed (the beat). Nothing new enters.
- NO DAMAGE BEFORE THE DIAL (standing) is amended by his words in section 4.

## 2. REACH IS SOMETHING HE FEELS
The numbers have existed since 9/4 (a tile is a house; pistol reaches 1, rifle 2, scope 3) and
he cannot feel them. From now:
- When he holds a weapon, ITS REACH IS LIT ON THE TILES around him: one tile for a pistol, two
  for a rifle, three for a scope. The lit tiles are the only tiles he can shoot into.
- A man outside the reach cannot be shot, and it says so when he tries (a dead press is the
  worst bug; a refused press says why).
- Stepping in and out of reach is the dance: his step, their step, on the beat.
- The enemies play the same rule back at him on their beat, visibly: their reach is lit on
  their turn so he can see what he is standing in.
- GUNS ARE BAD IN CLOSE (8/28) stands: inside one tile the pistol is a club.

## 3. NO RESTART OF THE BOARD; THE RULES ARE REBUILT ON IT
He asked whether combat has to be restarted from the ground up. The manager's answer, built
rather than asked: NO for the board and the bodies (V222/V223: the ground is his approved street
byte for byte, the fighter is 112, DIRECTION passed the seam), YES for the rules layer. The
fight's rules are rebuilt on that board as three things, in this order:
1. REACH YOU CAN SEE (section 2).
2. A TURN IS A BEAT. Both sides act on the beat; his press on the beat is his action; the
   companion acts on her gambits (FF12, combat only); an enemy's beat is visible before it
   lands (the preview is the tutorial). Quicker: a fight is over in beats, not minutes.
3. THE DIAL ONLY WHEN IT MATTERS (section 4).
Everything the fight already does that is not one of these three (perks, keys, the ladder's
verbs, the plates) stays wired and stays quiet until the three read on the glass.

## 4. THE DIAL IS FOR THE IMPORTANT SHOT
"The Dead Eye Dial can be a great idea for important parts of the combat to make it more fun
and engaging." NO DAMAGE BEFORE THE DIAL is amended by that sentence:
- ROUTINE EXCHANGES RESOLVE ON THE BEAT WITHOUT THE DIAL. A hit inside reach on the beat lands
  and costs ONE (EVERYTHING COSTS ONE). No dial, no pause, no number to read.
- THE DIAL COMES UP FOR THE SHOT THAT MATTERS: the kill shot, the boss, the called shot, the
  one that turns the fight. There it decides what that shot does, on the beat, the way it
  already works.
- THE DIAL STILL OWNS EVERY NUMBER BIGGER THAN ONE. Nothing adds flat damage beside it; the
  routine hit is one, the dial is the multiplier moment. His to correct in VOTE.
- Which shots are "important" is a short list the fight can read (a kill shot, a boss, a
  called shot), never a mood; COMBAT ships the list, DIRECTION judges whether the fight got
  more fun, he corrects.

## 5. WHO
- COMBAT [fight feel]: second line, right behind [fight looks], un-held (item 3). The three
  things of section 3, on the cut, walked with the one driver.
- UI [fight hud]: the reach lit on the tiles and the enemy's reach on their beat; drawn to the
  bible and 3-D (rule 22 panel 2).
- DIRECTION [judge the fight]: the verdict adds the FEEL column: does it read as Battle Brothers
  quicker (the two numbers: seconds cloud-to-over, his presses vs the companion's), and does
  the dial appear only when it matters.
- PLUMBER [fight headroom]: 60 on a phone is the floor for "quicker"; 7 fps is not a fight.
- SOUNDS: the beat and the cloud are the fight's sound; nothing else ships to it under the hold.

## 6. PUSH THE DEMO OUT
"I don't need the whole world." Rule 18 stands and is sharpened: the demo is the four things,
the fourth now including the feel of the third, and nothing else ships to it. The fleet keeps
making (rule 22) into VOTE. The manager says the cut holds when a stranger loads, walks, meets
a person with a face, and fights a fight that feels like this, for five minutes on a phone.

# LAW BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_COOK_EVERY_ROUND_9_21_26.md
# source: laws/BOHEMIA_ADDENDUM_COOK_EVERY_ROUND_9_21_26.md
====================================================================================================
# BOHEMIA ADDENDUM -- COOK EVERY ROUND (Paolo 9/21/26, LOCKED)
# His words, verbatim: records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_I_NEED_TO_SEE_THEM_COOKING_9_21_26.md. "I need the
# UI chat to be cooking up more... I'll enter the sound chat and it's not even making fucking
# sounds. It's coding and checking whether the sounds are broken or not... I need to be seeing
# them cooking up more, every time, not never."

## 1. THE LAW
A MAKING LANE COOKS EVERY ROUND. Every round of SOUNDS ends with a sound he can hear. Every
round of UI ends with a panel he can see at real size. COOK a tile or a prop, CHARACTER a
body or a garment, ANIMATION a clip, PORTRAIT a face, WORDS a set of lines in a mouth,
PEOPLE a person with a name and a face, LIFE+CITY a building or a block, FACTIONS a sign or
a flag, QUESTS an ask a person speaks, WORLD a thing on the phone. One real thing minimum,
registered in the VOTE tab, every round, or the round did not happen.

## 2. WHAT THIS AMENDS
Rule 18(b) of THE PLAYABLE CUT (9/20) said a held lane "spends the round measuring its part
of the three, or on school". That sentence is DEAD as a round's whole output. It made the
sound chat a checker. From now: THE HOLD IS ON THE PLAY SURFACE, NOT ON THE MAKING. Nothing
a held lane makes reaches the demo or the alpha's play tabs until the coordinator says the
cut holds; everything a held lane makes goes to the VOTE tab (in the alpha, rule 15), where
he hears it, sees it and votes. Measuring rides beside the cooking; school is round one of a
new question and never a second round in a row for a making lane.
STOP PRODUCING (7/26) is not touched: a lane he has FROZEN by verdict still produces nothing;
rule 18's hold is not a freeze, it is a queue, and the queue is the VOTE tab.

## 3. WHAT A ROUND LOOKS LIKE NOW, FOR THE TWO CHATS HE NAMED
SOUNDS: a round is sounds. Real audio he can play in the tab, on the beat, under the analog
horror law: the room hum for the BEGIN tap, the footstep that lands on the beat, the tape
drop-out of the step, the broadcast tone of the phone, a song through the dead speaker. The
instruments (the limiter, the audio-context count, the driver) stay in the proof line.
UI: a round is panels. The loading screen with BEGIN, the fight HUD, the talk panel with a
face, the notes box, the vote tab itself, each drawn 3-D (light and form, delivered as
pixels), each a picture at real phone size in the tab beside the flat one it replaces.

## 4. THE REPORT LEADS WITH THE THING
A making lane's round report and board line lead with WHAT WAS MADE and WHERE HE CAN HEAR OR
SEE IT (the VOTE tab, the item's id). Gates, mutations and measurements go after, in the
proof line. A report that leads with a gate is the shape he called "so fucking strange".

## 5. THE GATE (OWED, PLUMBER [cook gate])
The vote registry is the machine's record of cooking. PLUMBER builds the leg: for every
making lane, a round that lands a commit on main without registering at least one new item
in the VOTE registry is red on that lane's row. Until it exists, the coordinator reads the
registry every VAMILY and names, by chat, who cooked and who only checked.

## 6. THE VOTE TAB PLAYS SOUND
A sound he cannot hear in the tab is not cooked. UI [vote plays sound]: a sound item has a
play button and plays on the phone, on the beat, once, and the vote controls sit beside it.

## 7. ROUTING
Rule 22 on the front page. Every making lane's MODE line loses "spend the round measuring"
and gains COOK EVERY ROUND. SOUNDS [cook sounds] first line; UI [cook panels] first line
and [vote plays sound]; PLUMBER [cook gate].

# LAW BOHEMIA_LAW_THE_GROUND_MAY_ZOOM_THE_PERSON_MAY_NOT_9_21_26.md
# source: laws/BOHEMIA_LAW_THE_GROUND_MAY_ZOOM_THE_PERSON_MAY_NOT_9_21_26.md
====================================================================================================
# *** RE-READ 9/27 by laws/BOHEMIA_LAW_TWO_SCALES_ONE_GAME_9_27_26.md: the person is still ONE SIZE at every zoom, and that size is ONE CELL (about 28 px on a 32 px cell), not 112 px; the 112 art is an asset. ***
# BOHEMIA LAW -- THE GROUND MAY ZOOM, THE PERSON MAY NOT (coordinator 9/21/26, from four lanes' measurements of one defect)
# Paolo 9/20 (rule 18a): "I'm zooming out and my person becomes bigger." Paolo 9/18 (rule 17):
# "when combat started it was so fucking bad." Both sentences are the same bug.

## 1. THE LAW
A PERSON IS DRAWN AT ONE PIXEL SIZE ON EVERY SURFACE HE WALKS OR FIGHTS ON, and the camera
moves the GROUND under him, never his size. The ruled size is the one the street has shipped
at for months: a 112 px box, about 100 px of painted person (CHARACTER b6d2fcdc, 9/20). On
the street it is one size at every walk zoom. In the fight it is the same 112 box on a floor
the camera may pull back. Rule 16 (bodies larger) falls out for free: a fixed person on a
receding floor grows against the world with no new pixels. CITY mode from above keeps its
own ladder (a person is a speck from the sky); this law is about the walked and fought
surfaces.

## 2. WHY IT IS A LAW AND NOT A NOTE
The same defect was built twice, by two lanes, for the same good-sounding reason, and a
third lane had written the fix down before either built the bug:
- CHARACTER 9/15 wired the body to grow once a house fit the screen ("the readable way to
  honour rule 16"). Measured 9/20: three body sizes across the walk zooms (102/52/102/202),
  and a pinch from 22 to 44 DOUBLED him. His sentence exactly.
- COMBAT's fight ties the body to the floor's zoom (bodyScale = 1/FIELD_ZOOM, "the people
  ride the same number as the floor", so pulling back would not leave giants). Measured
  9/20 (CHARACTER ca1e1d1a): the same person is 3.03x smaller the moment a fight starts,
  37 px against 112.
- CHARACTER's own 9/15 record already said "the body's pixel size does not have to change
  at all" and the lane built the elastic body on top of it anyway (their words, 4996d242).
- RUN 9/20 sized the body off the camera stop and dropped that fix at the merge for
  CHARACTER's constant, because a constant is simpler and lands further (9049a4ea).
- ANIMATION 9/20 measured the same stop 4x different between two window widths because
  the size read the canvas width (0f75c655).
Tying the body to the camera LOOKS like the careful choice every time and produces a person
who changes size every time. A law that names the shape stops the fourth build.

## 3. THE GATE
On the street: gates/body_scale_gate.js (CHARACTER, 14/0, mutation-proved: elastic body back
= red; a fixed size nobody has played = red). In the fight: OWED to COMBAT [fight looks], the
same claim on the fight's canvas (the painted fighter reads 112 box, ~100 px), re-run with
CHARACTER's tool (records/BOHEMIA_IS_THE_FIGHTER_THE_SAME_SIZE_9_20_26.txt) until the two
lines read the same. Until that leg exists, THE FIGHT VERDICT carries the fighter's pixel
height as a number every round.

## 4. THE COST, SAID PLAINLY
He can no longer zoom in while walking (RUN 930e2bf3): one street view; the way to look
closer is to go and stand there. At the most zoomed-in level the fixed body is smaller
against the ground than it was; that cost disappears at the one camera. A person slightly
wrong at one zoom beats a person who doubles when you pinch.
